tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa ku ma ra ma ti'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gu ru ku ma ra ma ti yo na ma tha/ bden gnyis gnas lugs don rtogs mkhyen pa rgyas/ /byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs pa'i thugs rje can/ /mkhyen rab thugs rje 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od srung nye ba 'khor dang kun dga' bo/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya'i bla gos khri steng nas/ /nyams thag dbyangs kyis 'di skad bdag thos zhes/ /ston pa'i mdzad tshul gus pas brjod pa bzhin/ /bka' drin 'khor med chos rje rin po che/ /mthong ba'i skal med dran pa'i yul du gyur/ /nyin mtshan bsams kyang yon tan mtha' ma rtogs/ /cha yi cha tsam gus pas brjod bgyis na/ /thub bstan nub khar dar zhes gsungs pa'i don/ /bstan pa'i mjug 'dir skyes chen khyod byon nas/ /lta spyod nyams len rnam dag spel la dgongs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam bzhin srid bzhes chos ldan rigs su 'khrungs/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs yongs 'dzin mkhas mang bsten/ /sdom pa gsum blangs srog las gces par bzung / /thub pa'i ring lugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun la legs sbyangs nas/ /rtag chad mthar lta'i grub mtha' ma lus pa/ /rnam dag lung dang dngos stobs rigs pas bshig /log smra tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung rtogs yon tan thabs mkhas thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/ /ji bzhin mkhyen nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /skal ldan rjes 'dzin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /kun rdzob gnas lugs sgyu ma lta bur gzigs/ /don dam chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/ /lta ba rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bshes gnyen dul ba zhi zhing nyer zhi ba/ /sdom pa gsum ldan nyes ltung dri ma bral/

/sgo gsum ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang la bzhugs/ /spyod pa rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe 'di blos btang sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ /bden bzhi rten 'brel phyin drug rim gnyis sgom/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /nyams len rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs dam zab mo gnad du smin pa'i rtags/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs/ /rgyun du gzigs kyang rang rgyal brtul zhugs bsten/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi che btsun 'byor ldan gyis/ /gus pas spyan drangs rnyed dang bkur bstis mchod/ /dbang bskur sems bskyed gdams pa mang du zhus/ /kun gyis mchod 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'brug gi lo la mya ngan 'da' dgongs nas/ /go rtogs nyams su myong ba'i zab don rnams/ /ston pas bstan pa gtad pa ji bzhin du/ /chos 'khor nan 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor 'das chos kun skye ba med bstan nas/ /de nyid ngang la mya ngan 'da' bzhed na'ang / /gus pas gsol btab ngo la zhag bdun bar/ /sku tshe byin rlabs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi ba 'od gsal lus la brten mi srid/ /lus sems bral nas rnam shes stong par zhugs/ /dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal yin no zhes/ /yang yang gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar bsgoms 'pho ba'i man ngag gsal btab nas/ /rtags rnams ma brjed dga' spro 'od gsal 'jug /'gog las 'da' bzhin sngon gyi 'phan pas 'pho/ /gsung bzhin mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku tshe 'di yi dngos kyi gdul bya la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zin nas/ /'chi ba 'od gsal skabs su gzhan don gshegs/ /skye 'chi dbang thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pa rnam par dag /'od gsal don dam bden pa mngon du gyur/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes/ /phrin las lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhing gzhan gshegs tshe sa chen rab tu g.yos/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lha rnams 'dus gyur nas/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba de kho nas/ /mchod nas spyan drangs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes me yis khyod sku bzhu ba'i tshe/ /mkha' la sprin med bar snang rlung yang zhi/ /sa la drod rgyas dbyar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ /rten 'brel dbang thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa'i sku gdung cha brgyad bsgos pa bzhin/ /khyod gdung dad ldan lha yis grangs med kyi/ /phyogs bcur spyan drangs mchod pa'i rten du gyur/ /sku gdung rgyas mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthong thos dran reg gtam du brjod rnams kyis/ /'di phyi bar do'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad/ /bslu med skyabs gnas dpal ldan red mda' ba/ /'dren mchog dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ma kye hud bstan pa'i srog shing chag /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun phyogs bcur 'thor lags so/ /kye ma kye hud thar pa'i rgyal mtshan 'gyel/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi thar lam stor lags so/ /kye ma kye hud legs bshad dga' ston nyams/ /blo gsal rnams kyi re thag chad lags so/ /kye ma kye hud lta ba'i nyi ma nub/ /klu sgrub yab sras lugs bzang su yis ston/ /kye ma kye hud dam chos rgya mtsho skams/ /thogs med sku mched bshad srol su yis skyong / /kye ma kye hud lung rigs mche sder 'thor/ /phyogs glang chos grags rigs tshul su yis spel/ /kye ma kye hud tshul khrims bum pa zhig /yon shag rnam gnyis sdom rgyun su yis 'dzin/ /kye ma kye hud spangs rtogs go rim 'chol/ /'phags seng gnyis kyi legs bshad su yis sgrogs/ /kye ma kye hud nyams rtogs byin rlabs yal/ /ti lo nā ro'i man ngag su la zhu/ /kye ma kye hud phan bde'i pad tshal zum/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa cig char nub lags so/ /kye ma kye hud nyams thag yi re mug /khyod sku mig gis mthong ba'i skal bas dben/

khyod gsung rna bas thos pa'i bsod nams med/ /khyod thugs gang na bzhugs kyang byin gyis rlobs/ /dge legs yon tan chu gter chen po las/ /chu thigs tsam zhig blangs la nyes pa'i tshogs/ /ji snyed mchis pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /zhabs 'bring gnyug ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /bla ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung 'di/ /bshes gnyen bsod nams grags sogs bkas bskul nas/ /grangs med gdul bya'i tha shal mnga' ris pa/ /mi phyed dad thob sangs rgyas rtse mos sbyar/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan/ /ma lus blo yis gcig tu sdom byas nas/ /bla ma mchog la gus pas phul ba yis/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar 'khyongs pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlabs tu gsol// ༈ //bden gnyis gnas lugs don rtogs mkhyen pa rgyas/ /byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs pa'i thugs rje can/ /mkhyen rab thugs rje 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i bdag nyid mkhas pa'i dbang po dpal ldan red mda' ba zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis kun rdzob kyi bden pa gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad spyi mtshan rang gi dngos pos stong par thugs su chud cing / rang mtshan lag mthil gyi skyu ru ra ltar gzigs pa ji snyed pa mkhyen pa dang / don dam pa'i bden pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar thugs su chud pa ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' bas na mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas pa'o/ /'gro ba mtha' dag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol bar 'dod pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i go bgos shing sgrol bar byed pa'i sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i brtson grus dang ldan pas smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi thugs gnyis 'byongs pas na thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'o/

/de lta bu'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje mnyam pa'am lhag pa gangs can gyi khrod na med pas 'gran zla dang bral ba'o/ /bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs snga nas/ srid zhi stong par lta ba'i shes rab dang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro la dmigs pa'i snying rje gnyis/ /res 'ga' res 'jog res 'ga' zung 'brel sgom/ /zhes gsungs/ chos rje blo bzang pas bstod par/ dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan red mda' ba/ /gzhon nu blo gros zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan zhing dbang rgyud man ngag phyin ci ma log pa thob cing / thugs su chud nas ston pa bla ma'i sku'i cha thams cad kyi dman pa zhabs kyi pad+mo la rang gi yan lag kun gyi mchog spyi bos 'dud pa lus dang / gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs kyis bstod pa ngag dang / dad cing gus pa bskyed pa yid de sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /'od srung nye bar 'khor dang kun dga' bo/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya'i bla gos khri steng nas/ /nyams thag dbyangs kyis 'di skad bdag thos zhes/ /ston pa'i mdzad tshul gus pas brjod pa bzhin/ /zhes pa ni/ ston pa'i nyan thos brgyad khri bzhi stong gi nang nas sbyangs pa dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / mang du thos pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa 'od srungs dang / nye bar 'khor dang kun dga' bos ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu/ bstan pa dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ bstan 'dzin dgra bcom pa lnga brgyar gcig gis ma tshang ba bsdus nas/ de dag gi bla gos kyi khri steng nas ston pa'i yon tan dran nas nyams thag gi dbyangs kyis 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la zhes sogs kyis sgo nas/ ston pas dang po byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed/

bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ tha mar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i tshul mngon pa 'dul ba mdo'i sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum legs par bsdus pa bzhin du/ bka' drin 'khor med chos rje rin po che/ /mthong ba'i skal med dran pa'i yul du gyur/ /nyin mtshan bsams kyang yon tan mtha' ma rtogs/ /cha yi cha tsam gus pas brjod gyis na/ /zhes pa ni/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams la yang dag pa'i lam bstan pas bka' drin 'khor ba med pa'i chos rje rin po che de nyid mig shes kyis mngon sum du mthong ba'i skal ba med cing / yid shes kyi dran pa'i yul 'ba' zhig tu gyur te/ nyin dang mtshan du gus pas bsams kyang / lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi pha mtha' rtogs par ma nus te/ mkhan chen chos rgyal bas bstod par/ bshes gnyen mkha' lding dbang po rnams kyis kyang / /khyod kyi yon tan mkha' mtha' ma mthong na/ /bdag gi blo gros phye ma leb lta bus/ /de ni dpog par nus pa ga la yin/ /zhes so/ /de lta na yang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par mthong zhing thos pa'i yon tan gyi cha'i cha tsam sgro 'dogs dang gcam bu spangs nas gus pas brjod par bgyi na/ thub bstan nub khar dar zhes gsungs pa'i don/ /bstan pa'i mjug 'dir skyes chen khyod byon nas/ /lta spyod nyams len rnam dag spel la dgongs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ mdo las/ mar me 'chi khar gsal ba ltar/ /nga'i bstan pa nub khar dar zhes lung bstan pa'i dgongs pa ni/ yang snying bstan pa'i mjug 'dir mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen khyod byon nas/ lta ba dang spyod pa nyams len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa la dgongs pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngar gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mkhas pa'i dbang po mang du byon na yang 'ga' zhig gis lta ba'i cha kho na gsal bar mdzad/

'ga' zhig gis spyod pa'i phyogs kho na gsal bar mdzad/ 'ga' zhig gis nyams len gyi gnad kho na gsal bar mdzad pa tsam du zad kyi/ bshad sgrub gnyis ka'i sgo nas bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa khyod las sngar gzhan la byung bar mthong zhing thos pas khums shing / phyis kyang mi 'byung ste/ bdag nyid chen po'i gsung las/ mang pos bskur bas chen por grags rnams kyis/ /rnyed dang bkur sti grags pa lhur byed kyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ched cher mi 'dzin na/ /'di na thub bstan gces 'dzin dam pa su/ /mkhas rlom phal cher smra mkhas ne tso bzhin/ /tshig gi rjes 'brang gzhung tsam klog par zad/ /rigs dang mi rigs 'byed la 'thoms gyur na/ /'di na rigs ldan legs bshad smra ba gang / /nyin dang mtshan du rnal 'byor sgom rnams kyang / /lhag dpyod kyis ni ting 'dzin sgom pa bzhin/ /yang dag lta ba'i gnad kyis dben gyur na/ /'di na yang dag lam zhugs sgrub po med/ /lto phyir rab byung gral phyir bsnyen rdzogs kyang / /tshul ldan bslab la gus pa'i dge sbyor nyung / /kye ma kye hud shākya'i bstan pa ni/ /ming tsam lus pa kho bo gcig pus mthong / /zhes dang / blo'i bstod par/ klu sgrub thogs med gnyis kyi bzhed pa'i lugs/ /ji bzhin thugs su chud nas brtse ba yis/ /skyon bral gsung gi gsang ba legs 'doms pa/ /bstan pa'i gnad la nges pa ster ba 'di/ /khyod kyi rjes su bstan la gzhan su zhig /ces so/ /bsam bzhin srid bzhes chos ldan rigs su 'khrungs/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs yongs 'dzin mkhas mang bsten/ /sdom pa gsum blangs srog las gces par bzung / /thub pa'i ring lugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di sku tshe snga ma kha che paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs nas/ chos rje blo bzang grags pa paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti bha drar gyur pas gtso mdzad gdul bya bsam gyi mi khyab pa la chos sde snod gsum/

rgyud sde bzhi'i don phyin ci ma log par bstan nas/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad tshul gsang bdag gis phyag rdor grub thob la gsung pa yin/ de nas bsam bzhin du gangs ri'i khrod 'dir lta spyod nyams len phyin ci log tu spyod pa rnams tshar bcad pa'i phyir/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya dang nye ba na red mda' khab sor grags pa der/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i nang blon/ blon po mgar stong btsan yul srungs kyi rgyud pa/ yab red mda'i blon chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / yum lhag bsam rnam par dag pa bram ze ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims dang tshul mtshungs pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma slob dpon mo dbang phyug skyid zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su gyur te lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe yum la nyi zla shar ba dang sgron me spar ba dang gtsug lag khang bzheng ba sogs rmi ltas bzang po mang po byung zhing / lus sdug bsngal dang bral/ sems bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ btsas pa'i tshe na yang yum sras gnyis ka la btsa' ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur to/ /chos bstod par/ khyod ni lum bi'i tshal du rgyal ba bzhin/ /dri med yum gyi lhums nas bltams pa'i tshe/ /bsod nams phung po khyod sku ma bzung phyir/ /tshangs dbang nyid du gyur ram yang na shi/ /zhes so/ /de nas 'o ma dang / zho dang mar gyi snying khu sogs kyis bskyed srings te/ mtshan yang btsun ne zhes bya bar gsol te/ smra shes don go tshun chad dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra thos pa'am rten mthong ba na dad cing gus pa chen por skye ba byung / yab yum gnyis ka gzhon nu'i dus su 'das shing / a ne mtshan ldan gyi mkha' 'gro ma bkra shis 'bum zhes bya bas/ gzhon nu nyid nas mkhas pa'i dbang po chen por gyur gyi bar du zhabs tog skyo ngal med pa phul bas shin tu drin che gsung / bdag nyid chen po 'di byis pa'i dus su/

a ne la ngas yang na sa skya dpon chen gyi lag rtags blangs nas bod khams bde ba la 'god/ yang na bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar byed gsungs pas/ a ne na re/ btsun ne blo gros che/ khyod kyis de gnyis ka mi 'grub par 'dug gi ham pa ma che zer/ de dus mtshan yang btsun ne blo gros cher grags pa yang byung / de dus 'phags chen chos bzang dpal ba la skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa sogs thugs rje chen po'i chos skor mang du zhus/ de nas bdag nyin chen po'i thugs la/ dal 'byor don dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ bstan pa'i sgor 'jug dgos dgongs nas gangs can gyi ngur smrig 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan dam par gyur pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen pa'i drung du/ dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa dgung lo bco brgyad pa la nod nas/ mtshan yang gzhon nu blo gros zhes gsol/ de nas shes bya'i gnas thams cad la 'jug par byed pa'i sgo bka' spyi'i dgongs 'grel/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel la gzigs par dgongs nas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po nya dbon kun dga' dang / lung rigs smra ba'i seṅge mkhan chen sangs rgyas 'phel gnyis kyi zhabs la gtugs te/ blo gros sbyangs pas rnam 'grel la go ba tho re ba chags pa byung nas/ grwa skor mdzad pas thugs rab che ba'i grags pa thob/ de dus rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal ba'i mtshan thos pa tsam la ba spu g.yo zhing mig mchi ma 'dzag pa sogs byung nas/ dngul chu'i chos rdzong du byon te/ sems dpa' chen po'i drung du smon 'jug sems bskyed blangs/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong la sogs pa'i chos skor mang du zhus so/ /de nas gdan sar byon nas chos khri thang du lan 'debs gcig mdzad pas/ gzhung la sbyor ba bde sar zhig la 'khod pa la/ grwa skor bas ma shes na'ang / khong pa rang la rang gi thugs shin tu khrel ba zhig byung nas/

rnam 'grel gyi gzhung kho rang 'di ci zer shes pa gcig ma byung na slob dpon gyi ngag rgyun gyis bslu bar 'dug dgongs nas/ sa skyar dpe mtshams bcad nas gzhung la brgya tshar bcug te/ sde bdun mdo 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa la gzigs/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang / 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seṅge'i legs bshad rnams la yang gzigs/ slob dpon che chung gnyis la chos mang du gsan pas sde bdun dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i don phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud nas/ mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng khyab par gyur te/ rnam 'grel la 'grel pa che chung gnyis spyi don dang bcas pa mdzad nas/ gang gi legs bshad tsha zer phra mos kyang / /mkhas rlom me khyer bye ba'i gzi 'phrog cing / /rigs tshul 'bum phrag stong gi zer 'phro ba'i/ /blo gros 'di ni sngon med nyi ma yin/ /kun gzhi'i mngal las thos pa'i sa bon rnams/ /shes rab yum gyis legs bskrun brtson 'grus kyi/ ma mas rgyun du skyongs pas gangs can 'dir/ /dpal ldan grags pa'i gdung 'tshob kho bo 'khrungs/ /de lta na yang gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru/ /mkhas rmongs 'byed pa'i tshul la mi mkhas pas/ /nya pa'i lag tu rin chen 'grims pa ltar/ /blo ngan 'ching bu'i tshogs dang mnyam du spel/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin rig pa'i mche sder gyis/ /phas rgol glang po'i klad pa 'gems nus kyang / /legs nyes 'byed pa'i gzu bos dben pas na/ /smra ngan wa skyes tshogs kyang rtag tu rgol/ /zhes gsungs shing / blo'i bstod par/ rig tshul brgya phrag du ma'i ro ldan pa'i/ /blo chen ldan rnams dga' ba skyed byed pa/ /rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i thun mong min pa'i lugs/ /yongs su rdzogs pa smra ba khyod du bas/ /zhes dang / sde bdun ral pa 'thug pos gnya' khebs cing / /mdo yi stobs rgyas 'grel bshad so so'i khyogs/ /nyid kyi shes rab ngan pas glud 'phen pa/

/tshad ma ri bo'i sul na rgyu ba lags/ /zhes so/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa gtso bor ston pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po'i gsung / mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa la gzigs par dgongs nas phar phyin gyi gzhung par ma gcig dbu sngas su bcug ste gzims pa'i mtshan lam du/ rgya gar skad nas/ rdzogs so'i bar gzhung ma lus pa 'bur du dod pa zung nyan pa byung / re re nas blang nas zhal du gsol bas ro mchog dang ldan pa byung zhing / mnal sad pa dang shin tu dgyes par gyur nas/ de ring ngas ji tsam zin lta dgos dgongs nas bzung bas/ bam po dang po tsha phyi la zin pa byung gsung / gzhung thugs su chud pa dang lung chos kyi go ba cha ze ba chags pa byung na yang / shin tu mkhas pa byed dgongs nas/ skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sogs pa yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams la gsan zhing khyad par nyi khri snang ba dang / brgyad stong 'grel chen la sogs pa rgya 'grel rnams dang / 'bre ar gyi 'grel bshad sogs bod 'grel rnams la gzigs pas/ 'phags seng gnyis kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud nas/ phar phyin gyi ṭīka sbyor ṭīka don bdun cu rnams mdzad de/ tshig gi rjes 'brang byis pa'i blo can rnams/ /sngon rab bshad srol bzlas pas mgu na yang / /'bras med spun pa 'phyar ba ngal mthong nas/ /gzhan zer rnam grangs zlos pa kho bos spangs/ /spyi don gzhung brgya'i tshul dang mi 'gal zhing / /tshig don dngos stobs rig pas sgrub pa la/ /mkhas rlom mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams kyi/ /yun ring brtags kyang klan ka'i skabs med do/ /zhes gsungs/ chos kyi nyi mas bstod par/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi bzhed gzhung gzhan dag kyang / /lan re tsam gyis ma lus mthar phyin phyir/ /rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho yi/

/pha rol son pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des chos thams cad kyi ma mo mngon pa'i sde snod la gzigs par dgongs nas/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po byang chub rtse mo'i zhabs la gtugs te/ mngon pa gong 'og tshar mang du gsan cing / rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga/ bsdus pa'i bstan bcos sdom rnam gnyis/ pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa la gzigs shing / mkhas pa'i dbang po dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i legs bshad sogs la gzigs pas thogs med sku mched kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud nas mngon pa gong 'og gi ṭī ka bsdus don dang bcas pa mdzad de/ mkha' 'gro'i dbang po mkha' la spyod pa'i mtshan ma rjes su mthong gyur nas/ 'dab ma shin tu rgyas pa min pa'ang de yi rjes su slob pa ltar/ /blo gros stobs ldan sngon rab mkhas pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas bshad pa la/ /phrag dog sgo nas smod par byed kyang 'di la nyes pa cung zad med/ /ces gsungs/ blo bstod par/ stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa'i ring lugs pa/ /rnam rig shing rta'i srol 'byed 'dzam gling rgyan/ /gang gis bde bar gshegs kyi gdung 'tshob pa/ /thogs med sku mched gnyis kyi bzhed pa'i lugs/ /ji bzhin thugs su chud pa'ang khyod du bas/ /zhes so/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des bstan pa'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa/ dge slong gi sdom pa nod nas 'dul ba'i bslab bya phyin ci ma log par len pa'i srol gtod dgos par dgongs nas/ gnas brtan dgra bcom pa chen po/ mdog lhod pa mkhan chen kun dga' dpal bzang po'i drung du byon nas/ mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa nod nas/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa tshar gcig gsan pas mkhan chen pa la yang thugs skyed thon pa byung / lta khrid kyang zhus/ chos grol ba dang mkhan chen pas ja bur gcig gnang nas/

khyed skyes stobs kyi thugs rab che zhing / gzhung lugs gzhan la'ang sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis 'dul ba la'ang nged pas khyod shin tu mkhas pa gcig byung bar gda' 'o/ /chos bdag po la 'phrod lags so/ /'di la khyed kyis ṭī ka gcig kyang mdzod/ stod 'dul gyi sdom rgyun 'di ma chad pa gcig 'tshal lo/ /gsung ba'i zhal lta bzang po gnang ba dang du blangs te/ 'dul lung dang rgya 'grel rnams dang / bya khyi sog gsum la sogs pa bod kyi 'grel bshad rnams la gzigs pas/ yon shāka rnam gnyis kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud cing / mdo rtsa ba'i ṭī ka dang / las chog gnyis mdzad nas de phyin chad 'chad nyan mdzad dus kyang / dbyar gnas dang gso sbyong dang dgag dbye sogs ma chag par mdzad do/ /yon tan 'od ces sa gsum rab grags pa/ /rgyal ba'i ring lugs 'dzin pa des mdzad pa/ /thub pa'i nang mdzod 'dul ba 'bum sde'i don/ /ma lus sdud byed legs bshad 'di byas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /blo bstod par/ thub pas lan cig min par bsngags pa yi/ /tshul khrims 'phags pa'i nor du gzigs nas ni/ /nyer sbas zla ba'i nor bu yon tan 'od/ /thams cad yod smra mkhas pa'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /'dul ba 'bum sde dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi/ /bslab pa'i gnas la mkhas shing 'da' mi byed/ /zhes so/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des snying po'i don gtso bor ston pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs la gzigs par bzhed na'ang / de dus gangs ri'i khrod na dbu ma'i bka' ma chad tsam ma gtogs 'chad nyan gyi gtan la 'bebs pa dang sgom sgrub kyis nyams su len pa'i srol nyams par gyur nas/ thugs shin tu chad par gyur kyang / bshad pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la zhu dgongs na'ang / dbus na bzhugs pas ma byung bar chos rje byang seng ba la rigs tshogs bzhi brgya pa 'jug pa sogs dbu ma'i skor rnams gsan nas dkon mchog la gsol ba btab/

thugs rab kyis yang yang dpyad pas sngon gyi smon lam dang / sbyangs pa'i mthu dang / dkon mchog gi byin rlabs la brten nas klu sgrub yab sras dpal ldan zla ba dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud cing / mkhas pa chen po legs ldan 'byed rang rgyud shar gsum gyi gzhung lugs rnams kyang ma 'dres par mkhyen nas 'chad nyan gyis legs par gtan la phab/ de'i dus su slob ma rnams kyis rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs gal che ba rnams la yid 'jog re mdzad par zhu zhes yang yang gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/ tshig gsal gyi stong thun gyi 'grel ba rnams mdzad nas/ dpon slob thams cad kyis 'chad nyan mdzad pas dbu ma'i 'chad nyan gyi srol legs par gtod pa'i mthu la brten nas/ de'i dus su chos kyi rje grags pa rgyal mtshan zhang dbon lo ts+tsha ba skyabs mchog dpal khu dbon/ mkhas pa chen po g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dpon slob rnams kyis kyang dbu ma 'chad nyan mdzad pas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dbu ma'i bshad srol dar zhing rgyas par gyur kyang / phal cher rang rgyud kyi lta ba'i thog tu gnas shing / thal 'gyur gyi lta ba thugs su chud pa tsam ma byung 'dug ste/ 'di tsam yang dga' mo yin/ nga dang po slob gnyer byed dus sa skya sogs na dbu ma'i dpe cha gcig 'dug zer nas nor mi cher byed pa 'dug /deng sang dbu ma'i dpe cha la rtsis byed pa 'di yang / kho bos bstan pa la bya ba byas pa yin gsungs/ karma pa dkon gzhon gyi gsungs gis/ deng sang gangs ri'i khrod na mkhas pa dang / blun po kun kha dbu ma sna dbu ma zer ba 'di red mda' ba'i drin yin/ de gong du thang sag na dbu ma shi ro gcig 'dug zer/ gzhan yod pa'i lab ma thos gsung / rgya gar bal po bod kyi yul rnams su/ /mdo don smra ba'i mkhas pa mang byon yang / /phal cher rtogs pas sbyar ba'i don tsam la/ /mkhas par zad kyi de nyid don la min/

/thub pa'i bstan pa nyid kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ /'khrul med smra ba 'phags pa klu sgrub yin/ /de'i bzhed gzhung rab dkar kun da'i tshal/ /ji bzhin 'byed mkhas dpal ldan zla ba yin/ /slob dpon de dag dgongs pa 'di yin zhes/ /mkhas rlom mang yang su la ci cha yod/ /rnam bkra tshon gyi ri mo gsal ba yi/ /rnam dbye dmus long dag la yod dam ci/ /long bas rin chen gter kha phyed pa ltar/ /rnam dag 'phags pa'i mig dang mi ldan yang / /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi byin rlabs las/ /rten 'byung zab mo'i lam 'di kho bos rnyed/ /ces gsung / blo bstod par/ stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa'i ring lugs pa/ /mtha' bral shing rta'i srol 'byed 'dzam gling rgyan/ /gang gis bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung 'tshob pa/ /klu sgrub zla grags gnyis kyi bzhed pa'i lugs/ /ji bzhin thugs su chud pa'ang khyod du bas/ /zhes dang / chos rje mthar lta'i g.yang sa ring du spangs gyur la/ /dus gsum gshegs pa rnams kyi bgrod pa'i shul/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i 'jigs pa las grol ba/ /dbu ma'i lam nas khyod ni gshegs pa lags/ /zhes dang / nyi snyigs ma'i dus 'dir ngan rtog chang gis myos gyur pas/ /de nyid don la skye bo rnams ni 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /gang gis spros kun bsal nas stong nyid zab mo'i don/ /yang dag legs rtogs rnam dpyod 'di ni e ma mtshar/ /zhes so/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po des theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse rdo rje theg pa la 'jug par dgongs nas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po byang chub rtse mo'i drung du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje la sogs pa'i dbang 'ga' zhus/ gsang mtshan yang mi bskyod rdo rjer gsol/ rgyud lo ts+tsha ba nam bzang la zhus/ man ngag chos kyi rje grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du zhus/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du dgyes pa rdo rje la sogs pa'i dbang 'ga' zhus/

lo ts+tsha ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang po la rgyud kyi bshad pa zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan pa'i drung du lam 'bras man ngag chos skyong che chung gi skor dang bcas pa zhus/ sa bzang paṇa chen pa'i drung du bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang 'ga' zhus/ chos rje skyabs mchog pa'i drung du rdo rje phreng ba/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /sa skya pa'i pha chos rdo rje gzhon nu sogs mang du zhus/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga mdor byas/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i spyod bsdus sgros ma/ dpal ldan zla bas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus sgron gsal la sogs pa 'phags lugs kyi rgya 'grel thams cad dang / rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi la sogs pa gsang 'dus snga srol ba rnams kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa/ shan+ti pas mdzad pa'i bshad sbyar snye ma'i me tog dang / ye shes zhabs kyi mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po/ mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bzhi brgya pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ tha ka na'i 'grel pa/ rgyal bas byin gyi 'grel pa la sogs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lugs gsum gyi rgya 'grel rnams dang / bod kyi rje 'gos bdog klan gsum dang / sa skya pa khu dbon/ rin po che bu ston la sogs pa'i legs bshad rnams la yang dag par gzigs rtogs mdzad pas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa'i tshig don ma lus pa thugs su chud nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur te/ gsang 'dus rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka dang / mngon rtogs bdag 'jug mchod phreng / rim lnga'i bsdus don la sogs pa mdzad nas/ 'phags pa rdo rje'i man ngag dang / bshad rgyud gzhan gyi rjes su 'brang nas/ 'dus pa'i rgyud chen rim pa lngar/ /dpal ldan zla ba grags pas bshad/ /sngon rab rgyud dang man ngag dang / /phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brang nas/ /rgyud don bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhir/ /rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas phye/

/'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi man ngag gi /rgyud don bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / /rdzogs rim thig le rnam gsum du/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis bstan/ /'phags dang mkhas pas gsal byas pa'i/ /'dus pa'i rgyud chen shing rta'i srol/ /rim pa gsum du phye ba'i don/ /rnyed pa gang de ya mtshan no/ /zhes gsungs/ blo bstod par/ thub pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ /ji snyed gsung pa kun gyi rtser gyur pa/ /rgyud sde'i mthar thug dpal ldan 'dus pa yi/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rgyas bstan rdo rje'i tshig /ji bzhin legs par phye nas rim gnyis kyi/ /ting 'dzin mchog gi bde la rol bas na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya'i sgra de yang / /mgon po khyod la don dang bcas pa 'jug /ces so/ /gong du bstan pa'i bla ma de rnams gus pas bsten pa yin te/ skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan chen po bsod rgyal dang / /rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal/ /ma ti paṇa chen paṇa chen byang rtse dang / /mkhas pa'i dbang po nya dbon kun dga' sogs/ /bka' drin nod pa'i bla ma bcu phrag gnyis/ /yun ring 'bad de gus pa'i gtsug gis bsten/ /zhes so/ /gong du bstan pa'i so thar dang byang sems rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa gsum yan lag dang bcas pa sku srog bas kyang gces par bsrungs pa yin te/ kho bos sangs rgyas bstan la rab byung nas/ /rigs dang mi rigs 'byed shes tshun chad du/ /lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa ci byed kyang / /rab tu sgrims te thub pa'i gsung bzhin sgrubs/ /thogs med goms pa'i nyon mongs shugs drag pas/ /gal te mi rigs cung zad byas na yang / /de yi mod la dug zos dran pa bzhin/ /'gyod sems ldan pas slar yang chos bzhin byas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos bstod par/ gzhan dag khas len chu yi ri mo bzhin/ /mang po nyid kyang phral du yal bar bgyid/ /khyod ni rdo la ri mo bris pa bzhin/

/shi yang dam bca' gzhan du bgyid ma lags/ /zhes so/ /bdag nyid chen po de ni thub pa'i ring lugs bla na med pa yin te/ nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud par/ rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste/ bcu dgu pa la byon zhing / zab mo lta ba'i brgyud par thub pa chen po nas bzung ste/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la byon la/ rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud par thub pa chen po nas bzung ste/ nyi shu rtsa bdun la byon nas rgyud pa gsum ka'i bka' brgyud sgrub brgyud dar rgyas su mdzad pa yin no/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun la legs sbyangs nas/ /rtag chad mthar lta'i grub mtha' ma lus pa/ /rnam dag lung dang dngos stobs rig pas bshig /log smra tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos de dag la legs par sbyangs pa yin te/ rgya gar nas 'gyur bstan bcos thams cad dang / /mdo dang rgyud sde phal cher legs par ltas/ /rang gzhan grub mtha'i de nyid 'byed pa la/ /mkhas mang 'dun sar 'jigs med spobs pa thob/ /ces gsungs/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dang po nas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che la mos pa zhig yod na'ang / slob dpon dang grogs mched kyis stobs kyisakun mkhyen chen po'i grub mtha' la 'dris ches pa gcig byung nas/ jo nang pa'i grub mtha'i rgyab brten/ rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo/ /mdo mya ngan las 'das pa chen po dgongs pa nges 'grel/ lang kar gshegs pa/ bstan bcos rgyud bla ma/ chos dbyings bstod pa sogs la brten par dgongs nas/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos de dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par blangs nas/ jo nang pa'i grub mtha' 'di gting tshugs pa zhig byed dgongs te/ man mun brag khar byon nas/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos dag la gzigs rtogs tshar gsum mdzad pas/ dang po la jo nang pa'i grub mtha' mdo rgyud bstan bcos de dag gi dgongs pa yin nges par 'dug dgongs pa byung /

gnyis pa la yin min the tshom za ba gcig byung / gsum pa la dgongs pa las phyin ci log du go ba zhig byung gsung / de nas gdan sar mkhan chen sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i drung du byon nas/ jo nang pa'i grub mtha' 'di mdo rgyud bstan bcos 'di dag gi dgongs pa yin bsam nas lta rtog zhib tu bgyis na'ang / dgongs pa las phyi rol tu gyur gda' lags zhus pas/ khyod mkhas drags pas shin tu bden gsung nas bca' bca' mdzad pa byung / de dus ston pa la springs yig mdzad pas/ mkhan chen pa shin tu ma mnyes nas 'khon 'dzin mdzad pa byung / de nas bdag nyid chen po 'di'i thugs la mkhan chen nya dbon pa 'di thugs rab che zhing tshad ma'i rigs pa la shin tu mkhas pa'i stobs kyis lung rigs kyi dgag sgrub zhus na 'gyur ba nges/ khong pa 'gyur na chu 'ol kha nas 'gyur nas deng sang gi jo nang pa thams cad 'gyur ba gcig 'ong bar 'dug dgongs nas rtse chen du nya dbon pa'i drung du byon pas/ skyo ma snga btsan la song nas/ dngos su mi skyon yang thugs mi mnyes pa'i rnal 'byor du ma ston kyin 'dug pas da zhus kyang don du mi 'gyur bar 'dug dgongs nas/ gdan sar log nas bstan 'dzin rnams la springs yig nor bu'i phreng ba mdzad pas/ gangs ri'i khrod na dus 'khor ba khas 'che ba rnams dang / khyad par du jo nang pa'i rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams dngos su rtsod par ma nus kyang / lkog tu rgyud cher 'khrugs par gyur to/ /de'i dus su drung bzhi thog pas gtso mdzad gdan sa chen po'i sde snod 'dzin pa rnams 'dzoms pa'i drung du/ bdag nyid chen pos dus 'khor la 'gal 'du yod gsungs/ karma dkon gzhon pas 'gal 'du med gsung nas rtsod pa'i skabs su/ karma pa na re/ shes bya chos can/ pad+ma dkar po blun por thal/ blun po bdag spyod 'dod ces pa de sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi gsung 'khrul med yin pa'i phyir/

gsal khyab khas blangs/ rtags grub te/ rgyud 'grel dri med 'od kyi rang lugs kyi tshig yin pa'i phyir zer ba la/ bdag nyid chen pos shes bya chos can/ sgra rtag mi rtag rtsod pa'i skabs su sgra de sgra mi rtag pa'i sgrub byed du thal/ rgyud 'grel dri med 'od nyid sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi gsung yin min rtsod pa'i skabs su rgyud 'grel dri med 'od kyi rang lugs kyi tshig yin pa de/ rgyud 'grel de nyid sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi gsung yin pa'i sgrub byed yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsung nas sun phyung zhing / gzhan yang bla ma shar chung ba la sogs pas yi ger bkod nas rtsod pa byung ba rnams kyang / sgrub byed sgrub bya dang mtshungs pa las ma byung gsung / jo nang pa'i phyogs kyi sngags pa gcig gis/ khyod mkhas pa chen po yin pa la/ dus 'khor la dgag pa mdzad pa mi 'os zhus pas/ de'i lan du/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la/ /dgag sgrub mkhas pa rnams kyis byed/ /mi rnams phying pa 'dra ba la/ /khyi la bcol gnyer ci zhig yod/ /ces gsung / de'i dus su mkhan chen bstan rgyal bas gtso mdzad jo nang pa rnams gros byas nas khong 'di zer na/ rang re 'di zer gyi lung rigs mang du brtsams nas/ 'jam dbyangs chen po la/ slob dpon gzhon blo pa 'dir spyan drongs/ bde gshegs snying po drang nges la rtsod pa yin zhus pas/ bdag nyid chen po slob dpon rnams sa skya nas spyan drangs rtsod pa'i dus su/ bdag nyid chen pos 'o skol rtsod pa byed na/ yang na rgyud/ yang na mdo/ yang na bstan bcos kho na'i steng nas byed/ blun po mgu pa'i rtsod pa pras ta pras te mi byed gsung zhing / 'jam dbyangs pas kyang de bzhin 'thad gsung zhus pas/ khong gis lkog gros byas pa'i lung rigs rnams zhig na'ang / dri bcas dang dri med kyi de bzhin nyid la khyad par med cing / stobs sogs 'dus ma byas kyi yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i bde gshegs snying po rtag brtan ther zug don dam bden par khas blangs pa la/

bdag nyid chen pos shes bya chos can/ rtag brtan gyi bde gshegs snying po bden par ma grub par thal/ de don dam par gcig du'ang ma grub du mar yang ma grub pa'i phyir/ gsal khyab khas blangs/ rtags ma grub na/ gcig tu grub na du ma la khyab pa bud/ du mar grub na gcig yin par bud/ gzhan yang shes bya chos can/ bde gshegs snying po bden 'dzin gyi blo spang du mi rung bar thal/ de bden par grub pa'i phyir gsung pa la/ slob dpon blo gros rdo rjes shes bya chos can/ spros bral du 'dzin pa'i blos spang du mi rung bar thal/ spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ khas blangs zer ba la/ de 'dra tshig 'dra tsam yin snying po med gsung / de la sogs pa'i lung rigs du mas jo nang pa'i grub mtha' la sngar zhugs pa log pa dang / 'jug pa the tshom za ba dang / phyis mi 'jug pa'i phrin las mdzad do/ /bdag nyid chen pos dus 'khor chos min gsung pa gangs can na grags na'ang / sgra ji bzhin pa la nang 'gal yod gsungs pa las/ chos min zhes ma gsungs te/ rtsod par/ 'on kyang 'phags pas mdzad dam min yang bla/ /legs par bshad pa'ang mang du mthong bas na/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs ma yin zhes/ /kho bo 'di la mtha' gcig bskur mi 'debs/ /zhes dang / 'gal spong du/ deng sang gangs ri'i khrod kyi mkhas rlom rnams/ /ldem po'i ngag gi zab mo'i tshul ston pa/ /dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa'i/ /tshig la ji bzhin sgra ru mngon zhen nas/ /rnam bzhag mdo rgyud tshogs dang 'gal ba yi/ /log pa'i chos lugs mang du spel mthong nas/ /'khyog po'i shing la srong ba'i tshul bzhin du/ /rgal shing brtag pa'i sgo nas bdag gis dris/ /zhes dang / nges don gsal byed du/ 'di don 'grel byed mkhas pa gzhan dag gis/ /snying po dor nas spun pa yang yang 'phyar/ /rgya mtsho srubs la bdud rtsi ji bzhin du/ /yang dag don gyi snying po kho bos blangs/

/'dab brgya'i tshal nas sbrang rtsi bung bas len/ /chu dang 'o ma ngang pas so sor 'byed/ /nor bu 'ching bu ded dpon mkhas pas shes/ /legs bshad nyes bshad mkhas pa'i blo yis rtogs/ /yod pa'i legs bshad phrag dog mun pas sgribs/ /med pa'i skyon rnams blo ngan mig gis mthong / /gdug pa'i sbrul gyis 'o ma 'thungs pa bzhin/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi nyon mongs dug 'phel ba'i/ /legs pa'i rgyun phyogs gzhom pa'i blo ngan rnams/ /legs bshad chu lon stong gis mi ldog mod/ /zur gnas blo ldan 'ga' yis 'di mthong nas/ /yid la 'bab 'gyur snyam nas ngas 'di sbyar/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar mdo rgyud bstan bcos de dag gi dgongs pa dang mthun na ga la 'gog chos sku rtag brtan ther zug 'dod pa sngar rgya bod bal gsum gang du ma byung zhing / da yang lta ba ngan pa la 'jug pa rgyun gcod pa'i phyir dgag pa mdzad de/ bde legs sa bon yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /yang dag lta ba'i nor mchog 'phrog byed cing / /thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod par byed pa yi/ /lta ngan las lhag phung byed dgra gzhan med/ /lta ngan dman pa'i thad la mngon zhen zhing / /rtag chad mthar lta'i wa skad cher sgrog pa/ /'di dag ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang na yang / /thub pa'i bstan la mu stegs than skyel yin/ /zhes gsungs/ de dus jo nang pa'i pho rus pa gcig gis mdog (ldog)na yar 'ongs pas/ mkhas pa gzhon blo ba dpon slob rnams 'byon gyi 'dug zer ba thos nas/ jo nang pa la nga mi gcig yod med med/ kho sod na jo nang pa'i dgra mgo chod pa 'dug bsams nas/ dbu la rdo brdeg pa'i dam bca' byas 'ongs/ drung pa dang mjal bas lus rengs sems dran pa nyams nas rdeg pa ma byung / kho dran pa rnyed pa dang dge bshes zil can zhig 'dug snyam pa byung / dus phyis drung pa la dad nas mthol bshags kyang phul bar grags so/ /'bri gung lo ts+tsha bas kyang jo nang pa'i pho rus byas nas/

bdag nyid chen po sreg ga'i sbyin sreg gi thab brtsegs bsregs grabs byas pa'i tshe na yang / nam mkhar mi dkar po gcig mngon sum du byung nas/ de khyod kyis bsregs kyang mi 'tshig rnam smin chen po sog pas ma byed zer nas 'phro la bzhag dgos byung bar grags/ bzang ldan du bka' bcu pa yon tan gyis/ jo nang pa la bka' bkyon mdzad pa 'di la sdig pa chen po 'ong ba 'dra/ zhus pas/ bdag nyid chen po'i gsung nas/ 'di 'dra zer ba shin tu mang ste/ de 'dra ga la yin/ sngon 'jig rten du ston pa byon pa'i dus su/ lha byin la sogs pa'i bdud rigs rnams dang / mu stegs kyi ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad la sogs pa phyi rol pa rnams la zhe sdang khong khro dpag med skyes pa'i sdig pa yang ston pa la 'ong ngam/ de'i rjes su rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs pa byon pa la/ nag phyogs rnams mi dga' bar gyur pa'i sdig pa yang de dag la 'ong ngam/ khyad par du 'phags pa klu sgrub byon nas theg pa chen po'i srol phye ba la rang sde gnyis kas theg chen bka' min zhes bskur pa btab pa'i sdig pa yang / 'phags mchog klu sgrub la 'ong ngam/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba'i tshe 'byung po'i bya rnams long ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin zhing / gnam thig drang po rgyab na sgur po ras su 'thon pa lugs yin/ blun po'i lab de 'dra ma zer gsungs/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon pa dang / /mkhas rnams bshad pa byed pa la/ /'bras bu rnam gsum 'byung ba 'di/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi lugs yin/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis chos bshad na/ /chos log spyod pa pham byed cing / /bdud rigs thams cad yi mug 'gyur/ /mkhas pa thams cad dga' bar byed/ /'di 'dras bstan pa 'dzin pa nus/ /zhes so/ /lta tshe chos kun rtag brtan 'dod/ /sgom tshe cir snang chos skur sprod/ /chos sku rgyud ldan lus can kun/

/las kyi 'khor ba 'khyams pa mtshar/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/ /mkhan chen g.yag pas/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya/ 'khor ba la zad pa med gsungs pa la/ bdag nyid chen pos/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya bar tshad mas nges pa thal/ der tshad mas grub pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pas/ g.yag pas khyab pa ma grub gsungs nas tshur ldog pas/ rtags ma grub la sogs pa'i 'phen lan mang du mdzad na'ang / don la ston pa'i mkhas pa rnams/ /bdag nyid chen po'i rigs pa la mnyes shing / tshig la ston pa'i mkhas pa rnams mkhan chen g.yag pa'i rigs pa la mnyes par grags so/ /chos rje lo ts+tsha ba dang / karma dkon gzhon gnyis/ kun rdzob yod pas yod pa'i go chod mi chod la rtsod pa mdzad pas/ rtsod pa 'brel mo ma byung bar lo ts+tsha ba'i gsung nas/ don la rtsod ni mi 'ong bar 'dug /tshig la snying po tsam med pas/ drung pa rnams 'o rgyal gzhan rnams kyang thugs dam 'chag pas bzhud gsung / de nas bdag nyid chen pos/ drung pa 'o rgyal/ bdag gis rtsod pas chog gsungs nas thar 'gyur 'ga' 'phangs pas/ karma pa la zug par thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub/ drung gi gsung nas/ dbus gtsang gi dge bshes chen por grags pa rnams kyang / don rgyab 'gal la song yang tshig phyogs tsam 'grig na rang re rtsod rgyu med/ grub mtha' mthun zhes smra/ don gcig kyang tshig cung zad mi mthun na/ mgo byang dug du song song rtsod kyin 'dug te/ de 'dra la snying po med/ drung lo ts+tsa ba la yang rigs pas ma dpyad par kun rdzob du yod pas yod pa'i go mi chod ni mi gsung / gsung na chad lta bar 'gyur/ karma pa yang rigs pas dpyad nas kyang kun rdzob du yod na yod pa'i go chod par mi 'dod na rtag ltar 'gyur/ gzhong stong la khyi 'thab mi dgos par gda' gsung / de dus nyan mkhan rnams na re/ bla ma'i zhabs tog du 'gro ba rang gi blo gros kyi nus pas thon pa ngo mtshar che zhes shin tu dad par gyur to/

/stag lung lo ts+tsha ba shāka bzang gis bka' bzhi pa gcig btang nas/ nged rgyan drug gi dgongs pa gcig tu 'dod pa yin/ khyed ji ltar bzhed zhus pas/ de la nges pa med/ gcig pa rnams ni gcig mi gcig pa rnams ni mi gcig par byas pas 'ong gsung / kho na re/ khyod mkhas pa chen po lags pas thag chod pa'i zhal lta gnang dgos zhes nan gyis zhus pas/ dgongs pa e gcig mi gcig 'di la shes mod/ klu sgrub yab sras rjes 'brang dang bcas pas thogs med sku mched rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs 'gegs par 'dug thogs med sku mched rjes 'brang dang bcas pas klu sgrub yab sras rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs 'gegs par 'dug de la thugs bsam btang bas shes/ lar dbu ma pa dang dngos smra ba grub mtha' gcig na/ dgongs pa mi gcig pa bya ba su yod pa yin/ zhes gad mo cher mdzad do/ /slob dpon bka' bcu pa dar mas yid ches 'bras rtags bla ma rin po che'i de dngos yin par gda' lags zhus pas/ khyed kyi de da dung skyor dang gsung / skyor bas grub mtha' de bzung na kha nag sbab la 'gro ba 'dug gsung / khong gis 'gro ba gyur cig ces gsungs nas/ smon lam 'debs na sku dbang che/ rigs pas ldog tu mi btub zhus pas/ 'o na sgur cig gsung nas/ thal 'gyur cig 'phangs pas/ 'khor gsum dngos 'gal la song zhing / lo zla ba bsams bsams pa tsho skad cig ma re la khur rgyug gsung / de dus dbu ma'i dge bshes kun na re/ blo bzang pa 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs/ gar gshegs su dpe cha mdzo rgyab bcu bzhi bkal nas nyin mtshan med par gzigs pa'i grub mtha' skyor bzang po/ dar ma lta bus skyar ba skad gcig re la bshig stong pa 'jigs su rung zhes ha las par gyur to/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras chen la sogs pa sngon gyi phyag chen pa 'ga' yis/ sku tshe snga ma yang yang du sbyangs shing / sku tshe 'dir yang rlung sems dbang du 'dus te gang byung gi chog na ci byas kyang sla ba rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa mdzad pa la 'khrul gzhi byas te/

deng sang gi phyag chen par bsgom pa phal mo che rnams ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la gces spras su mdzad pa dam pa rnams kyi lugs/ nyan thos kyi lugs zhes khyad du bsad nas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'o zhes tshig tu smra ba yang / don la bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i gnyen por cung zad kyang mi 'gro ba 'di dag ni chad par lta ba yin te/ lta bas spyod pa khyad du bsad nas bag med pa'i spyod pa lhur len pa las/ chad par lta rgyu gzhan med/ 'di dag ni so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas gnas lugs kyi don sgom pa rtog sgom skyon can du byed cing / yid la byed pa thams cad bkag te/ mi rtog pa thom po sgom pa la skyon med kyi sgom du byed par snang ste/ lugs 'di ni bstan pa las phyi rol tu gyur par ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las gsungs te/ 'jig rten pa dag ting 'dzin sgom byed kyang / /des ni bdag tu 'dzin pa zhig mi nus/ /des ni nyon mongs ches cher rab tu 'khrugs/ /lhag spyod kyi ni ting 'dzin 'di sgoms bzhin/ /gal te chos la bdag med so sor rtog /so sor de brtag sgom par byed pa ni/ /de nyid mya ngan 'das thob 'bras bu'i rgyu/ /rgyu gzhan gang yin des ni zhi mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gang dag dran pa dang yid byed bkag nas/ mun pa la mig gcer ltas byas te har sgom byed pa dang / mtshan ma ci yang yid la mi byed par/ rnam rtog thol skyes rbad chod byed pa ni/ rgya nag ha shang gi ring lugs ma nor ba yin gsungs/ deng sang gi bsgom chen pa 'ga' zhig shi rung las bla/ bar do zin pa yod zer ba mang ste/ nyin bar gyi snang ba 'di la a 'thas na rmi lam gyi 'khrul pa mi zin/ rmi lam ma zin par/ bar do'i 'khrul snang mi zin/ ro kha gdangs la grogs gnam babs la 'ong du res kyang mi 'ong gsung / de la sogs te lung dang rigs pa du ma'i sgo nas sun phyung bas/

sngar zhugs pa ldog pa dang / 'jug pa the tshom za ba dang / phyis mi 'jug pa la sogs pa'i phrin las mdzad do/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i chu gter la gnas te/ /gdengs can dbang po klu sgrub ring lugs 'dzin/ /kho bo'i lta zer 'bar ba'i gzi brjid la/ /phas rgol 'dab bzang stong gis 'geng mi nus/ /'jig tshogs lta ri spo mtho 'joms byed pa'i/ /lung rigs rdo rje'i gnam lcags stong yod kyang / /rmongs pa'i go cha sra brtan cher bgos pa'i/ /skye bo 'di la bdag gis ci byar yod/ /ces gsungs/ chos bstod par/ khyod ni rtsod pa mdzad tshe'ang dag pa dang / /rgya chen gzu bor gnas pa'i blo gros kyis/ /gzhan gyi phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yin/ /khyod la g.yo ba nam yang mnga' ma lags/ /zhes dang / blo smra ba ngan rnams tshar gcod pa'i/ /sun 'byin bgyid pa'i gnas rnams la/ /skyon yang yon tan lta bu dang / /yon tan skyon ltar snang ba yi/ /yang dag pa dang ltar snang gi /rnam par dbye ba legs par bstan/ /de ltar log par 'gro ba bkag /ces dang / stong nyid seṅge'i nga ro cher sgrogs shing / /lung dang rigs pa'i mche sder rab bgrad te/ /log par smra ba'i wa tshogs pham byas nas/ /thub mchog bstan pa gangs ri legs par 'dzin/ /de'i phyir da lta 'dzin pa'i khyon 'di na/ /che bar rlom pa mang du snang mod kyang / /blo chen 'di ni 'dzam gling rgyan gcig pu/ /gzur gnas blo ldan rnams kyis nges par gyis/ /zhes so/ /lung rtogs yon tan thabs mkhas thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pas chos kyi 'khor lo skor/ /skal ldan rjes 'dzin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ de ltar gong du bstan pa'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs shing / gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mkhas dang thugs rje chen po mnga' bas/ gdul bya'i khams theg pa che chung gi rigs so sor mkhyen zhing /

bsam pa dang dbang po rno brtul dang / bag la nyal nyon mongs pa shas che chung ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen zhing / chos kyi 'khor lo rang rang gi skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du theg pa che chung chos rgyas 'bring bsdus pa/ sde snod gsum la sogs pa gang la gang 'os kyi zab cing rgya che ba'i chos bstan/ smin grol thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam phyin ci ma log par bstan nas/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa rjes su bzung ba'i gtso bor gyur pa ni 'di dag ste/ sbyangs pa'i mchog gyur kun mkhyen sher 'od dang / /sras kyi mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /mang thos mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /'dul 'dzin mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /'phrin las mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /lta ba mchog gyur go gyo nyi ma grags/ /nyams len mchog gyur kun dga' dpal bzang po/ /brtse ldan mchog gyur dpal 'byor shes rab dang / /'chad mkhas mchog gyur bsod nams shes rab dang / /rtsod mkhas mchog gyur dar ma rin chen te/ /gzhung lugs rab 'byams mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen bdun/ /bka' bcu pa chen po nam mkha' byang chad ni/ de dag dang ngos mnyam du byed do/ /gzhan yang bka' bcu pa mang ra ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ bo dong bka' bcu pa grags pa tshul khrims/ byang pa bka' bcu pa bde legs dpal/ gnas rnying bka' bcu pa mchog grub la sogs pa rnams so/ /mdo stod pa bka' bzhi 'dzin pa spre'o thar bzang / gnyal gro gor jo gdan mtshungs med/ la stod pa mkhan chen bud+dha shrī/ bo dong pa chen po byang rgyal/ chen po byang bsod/ blo brtan/ bzang ldan pa don grub rin chen/ ngam ring pa dkon mchog dar/ mnga' ris pa yi dam dpal la sogs pa bka' bzhi 'dzin pa bcu phrag gcig gsung yang de las mang ba snang / lung rigs smra ba'i seṅge/ sgra tshad pa chos bzang / jo gdan grags she/ sngo phyi dbon po la sogs pa phar tshad mkhyen pa shin tu mang /

rigs pa smra ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ ri phug pa mkhan chen bsod nams skyabs/ dga' ldan pa mkhan chen shakya shrī la sogs pa rigs pa smra ba yang shin tu mang / stod lung pa bsod byang la sogs pa lung chos smra ba yang mang du byon/ 'di dag ni bdag nyid chen po'i gsung rab kho na las rtogs pa 'khrungs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po'i gsung rab la gzigs shing / sdom phrug rnams nyams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ bo dong mkhan chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa/ grags ram mkhan chen chos rgyal/ ngam ring mkhan chen rin chen dpal bzang / bzang ldan sde bdag slob dpon chen po/ las ston nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mkhyen ldan 'dar pa mgon seng / stag tshang mkhan po seṅge rgyal mtshan/ gsang phu gling stod mkhan chen 'od chen/ gling smad mkhan chen bsod nams 'phel/ bka' bzhi 'dzin pa chen po nag rig slob dpon chen po gnyal pa dang / rgyal dbang la sogs pa gsang phu'i slob dpon chen po phal che ba dang / dga' ba gdong mkhan chen bya yul rin po che/ lo mkhan po/ byang ra sgreng gi mkhan po go gnyis/ glang grags sher gsum gyi dbon chen/ stag sga chos lung gi mkhan po/ lha mdun gyi bla ma la sogs mnga' ris phyogs kyi sde snod 'dzin pa rnams te/ nyi zla ltar grags pa'i mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i slob rigs yin/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ku su lu'i slob rigs rnams kyi nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa sgra tshad la sogs thos pa'i yon tan dang ldan yang / ku su lu'i spyod pa skyong zhing gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems kyis thugs rgyud shin tu snum par byas pa/ chos kyi rje dz+nya na ba dang / lung rigs yon tan gyi khur gyi lci yang / ku su lu'i spyod pa kho na lhur len pa mchog bzang legs pa'i blo gros/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal rgyun du gzigs shing / ku su lu'i spyod pas nyin mtshan 'da' ba/

bla ma rmi lam pa brtson 'grus seṅge/ dbus pa bdag po'i bla ma chos rje rin bzang pa dang / tshe 'di blos btang zhing sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa ne rings pa sgrub pa dpal la sogs pa gnyug ma'i 'khor bya bral ba rnams so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i slob rigs kyi mchog tu gyur pa sa skya brang mo che'i mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan pa dang / chos rje lam 'bras pa blo bzang pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos dpal bzang po dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bla ma bsod grags pa/ bla ma rgyal bzang pa/ sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba la sogs rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma shin tu mang / gzhan yang rab tu byung ba'i gdul bya mtha' yas so/ /rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang bsod nams kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i slob rigs ni/ dzam+bu'i gling sum gnyis kyi bdag po rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa/ chos rgyal rnam gsum gyi dbon sras dam pa/ khri rgyal bsod nams sde yab yum sras dang bcas pa dang / dam pa 'ba' zhig byung byung ba'i rigs sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rgyud/ bla ma dbang gi sras po slob dpon chen po/ stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po se chen gnam gyi gdung rgyud/ gong ma dge sbyong ba/ stobs ldan sne'u dbon pa/ dad ldan yon tan rgya mtsho/ rigs ldan 'u yug lha btsun/ gnas rnying stong dpon rgyal bzang / 'byor ldan rgya chos stag gsum/ khungs btsun mnga' ris zhang blon 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa gdul bya mtha' yas pa la/ rgyu mngon par mtho ba dang / 'bras bu nges par legs pa la sogs pa'i thabs phyin ci ma logs pa thob pa'i thabs phyin ci ma logs pa bstan to/ /kun mkhyen sher mdo blo bzang grags pa sogs/ /gzhung lugs rab 'byams shes pa'i bshes gnyen bdun/ /bka' bzhi legs par smra ba bcu phrag gcig /phar tshad shes pa'i slob ma brgya phrag rgal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar dngos kyi gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung nas/

ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ gong du bstan pa'i legs par bshad pa'i rin po che'i phreng ba de rnams mdzad do/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan mchog bka' chen bzhi/ /rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum theg chen rgyud bla dang / /chos mngon mdzod dang dpal ldan 'dus pa sogs/ /rnam bshad byas pa'i gzhung lugs bcu phrag gcig /ces gsung / yang der ma 'dus pa lung kun las btus pa'i ṭī ka bshes pa'i spring yig gi ṭī ka gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog bdag 'jug mchod phreng / mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi snying po gcig tu bsdus pa/ go bde 'jug par sla ba'i man ngag rin po che bka' 'bum thor bu ba la sogs rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams kyi ston pa yi ge'i ngos na bzhugs pa deb lnga bcu rtsa lnga mdzad do/ /mdo las lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa'i tshe/ /nga ni yi ge'i ngos la gnas zhes gsungs so/ /blo bstod par/ mkhas pa dgyes pa'i lam du 'khrid/ /mang thos chud mi za ba'i rgyu/ /de don sgrub la'ang rab tu sbyor/ /de'i phyir khyod kyi gdul bya la/ /bgyi ba 'os pa ma lus mdzad/ /phan mdzad khyod la dus kun tu/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ bdag med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi/ /kun rdzob rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bur gzigs/ /don dam chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/ /lta ba rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab zab mos/ ma brtags nyams dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur kun rdzob rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba thams cad sgyu ma dang / rmi lam lta bur ma 'dres par so sor gzigs shing don dam pa'i bden pa chos kyi dbyings/ nam mkha'i dkyil ltar brjod du med pa'i don so sor rang gi rig pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i lta bar rnams par dag pa dang ldan pa yin te/ kho bo la dbu ma'i rtogs pa skye tshul bzhi byung ste/

'di ltar/ dang po chad stong / gnyis pa snang stong / gsum pa rten 'brel sgyu mar thob/ bzhi pa rten 'brel btags yod gzhi med du go ba'o/ /de la dang po ni bum pa tho bas bcom pa ltar kun rdzob rdzas yod rigs pas bshig pa'i stong pa nyid de/ 'dis kyang rigs chad kyi bden 'dzin zlog cing / stong nyid la mos pa'i rgyu tsam byed/ gnyis pa ni/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bur snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin med par rtogs pa ste/ 'dis phyi gzung ba la sgro bskur gyi rtog pa mtha' dag zlog kyang / nang myong rig la brod pa'i zhen pa mi 'dor bas sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i lta ba las ma 'das/ gsum pa ni/ nang myong rig dang phyi gzung ba gnyis ka yang rgyu rkyen la rag las pas/ sgyu ma ltar kun rdzob tu yang snang ba tsam las rang bzhin cung zad kyang med par rtogs pas te/ 'di la yang mtha' 'dzin gyi zhen pa ci yang med kyang / rten 'brel sgra rtog la ltos pa'i don chos sgyu ma tsam du 'dzin pa yod pas/ rnal 'byor dpyod pa'i dbu ma las ma 'das/ bzhi pa ni/ rten 'brel gyi chos rnams rigs pas tshul bzhin du dpyad pa na/ rang gi ngo bo cung zad kyang mi rnyed cing ma dpyad pa na tha snyad kyi yul du gyur pas rtogs pas btags shing ming gi tha snyad du byas pa tsam gyis btags yod du rtogs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rang bzhin gyis rten 'brel rtogs pa'i blo de nyid kyis/ blo gzhan la ltos med du rgyu 'bras phan tshun mi 'khrul ba dang / rten 'brel rtag chad/ spro ba'i mtha' thams cad bral ba gcig 'ong ba yin gsungs/ lta ba 'di gzhan gyi thugs yul du ma chud par chad lta yin zhes zer ba mang na yang / khas len thams cad dang bral ba'i lta ba 'di klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa yin te/ 'phags pa klu grub kyi zhal snga nas/ gal te ngas dam bcas 'ga' yod/ des na nga la skyon 'ga' yod/ nga la dam bca' med pas na/

nga ni skyon med kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'ga' zhig rang rgyud kyi dam bca' med/ rang lugs kyi dam bca' yod ces zer yang / ming spos tsam ma gtogs don la khyad par 'ga' yang med gsung / mkhas pa gzhan gyi lta ba bzang bzang por 'dod pa rnams kyang / bdag 'dzin la gros dris nas bzhag pa kho nar zad/ nga'i lta ba 'di yang / nga rang dang sdongs nas 'gro ba gcig 'ong bar 'dug gsung ste shin tu med de/ chos rje blo bzang pas 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs nas dbu ma'i lta ba dgongs tshul zhus pas/ da rung ma go gsung / 'o na nged dpon slob la khyad med pas/ slob dpon pas kyang ma dgongs sam zhus pas/ khong gis go yod/ zhib cha 'ga' yar ni ma go gsung / de ltar grags kyang / chos rje pa'i gdul bya pho rus che zhing mkhyen rab chung ba 'ga' zhig yab sras gnyis chos rje pa'i lta ba mchog yin te/ /'jam dbyangs kyi zhabs gzigs pa'i phyir zhes zer ba ni mi rigs te/ 'jam dbyangs dang mi dang mi bzhin du 'grogs shing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang / chos rje bas ches cher lhag pa'i bya ba mdzad pa paṇa chen zhi ba 'tshos kyang / thal 'gyur gyi lta ba thugs su ma chud par rgya bod kun tu grags shing don la'ang gnas te/ rang rgyud pa'i shing rta chen po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa dang dngos su mjal bas lta ba bzang la ma mjal bas lta ba ngan pa'i nges pa med de/ slob dpon chen po legs ldan 'byed dang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pa bzhin no/ /drung pa la chad lta yin zer mkhan bdog lags zhus pas/ yod nyen yod/ sngon ston pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus su/ dge slong go'u ta ma ni chad par smra ba'o zer mkhan mang du byung 'dug de'i rjes su klu sgrub yab sras/ dpal ldan zla ba khu byug che chung la yang de bzhin zer mkhan byung 'dug bod du yang dbu ma pa chen po gangs pa she'u/ khu mdo sde 'bar/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/

lce sgom zhig po sogs la'ang chad lta bar grags 'dug 'u yang chad lta ba yin yang grogs bzang bar yod kyi gsung / karma dkon gzhon gyis kyang / khyed chad lta ba yin byas pas/ nga chad lta ba e yin nga'i spyod pa 'di la ltos gsungs pas/ khyed shin tu mad par gda' 'o/ /bzod par gsol zhes zhus par grags/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ mngon sum byon nas dbyangs dang mgrin gcig gis/ /'di las gzhan du thar pa'i lam ston yang / /bdag blo g.yo ba med do grogs po dag /ces gsungs/ de ltar phyir mi ldog pa'i rtog pa brtan po thob pa yin no/ /bshes gnyen zhi ba dul ba nyer zhi ba/ /sdom pa gsum ldan nyes ltung dri ma bral/ /sgo gsum ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang la bzhugs/ /spyod pa rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di ni lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang ldan pas/ thugs rgyud shin tu dul la/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dang ldan pas rab tu zhi zhing / lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa dang ldan pas nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /so sor thar pa bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yan lag brgyad/ dge bsnyen gyi yan lag lnga/ dge tshul gyi yan lag bcu/ dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la nyes ltung dri ma'i skyon gyis ma gos pa yin te/ gang zhig legs gsungs dam chos 'dul ba la/ /rab tu byung nas legs par mi sdom zhing / /thub pa'i bka' lung tshul min zlog byed pa'i/ /dge sbyong de dag 'jig rten chom rkun yin/ /'khyog por smra la gzhan dag rling por sems/ /ngag mi btsun pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /bya rgyu'i sems dang de'i tshul spangs te/ /gsong por smra la kho bo rtag tu bsten/ /'dzem med smra ba gzhan dag spobs par sems/ /ngag mi sdom pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /mu cor smra ba smyon pa'i tshul spangs te/

/zhi ba'i tshul la kho bo rtag du bsten/ /phyi tshul 'chos pa gzhan dag btsun por sems/ /g.yo sgyu'i spyod pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /pha rol 'brid byed yon po'i tshul spangs te/ /des pa'i tshul la kho bo rtag tu bsten/ /rang dga'i spyod pa gzhan dag drang por sems/ /dbang po mi sdom dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /bag dang mi ldan hral po'i tshul spangs te/ /bag yod tshul la kho bo rtag tu brten/ /bya byed mang ba gzhan dag grung por sems/ /rnam g.yeng 'dod pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /'du 'dzis brel ba khyim pa'i tshul spangs te/ /don nyung tshul la kho bo rtag tu brten/ /longs spyod 'byor pa gzhan dag dpal du sems/ /'dod zhen che ba dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /zang zing dang bcas grong pa'i tshul spangs te/ /chos shes tshul la kho bo rtag tu brten/ /grong 'dabs 'grim pa gzhan dag gdul byar sems/ /rnyed bskur sgrub pa dge sbyong tshul min pa/ /khe spogs 'dod pa tshong pa'i tshul spangs te/ /bas mtha'i gnas la kho bo rtag tu brten/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong ba so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin no/ /gzhan phan mtha' dag sgrub pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyang rnam par dag pa yin te/ rnyed dang bskur bsti chags pa yis/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / /zhes pa'i nyes pas ma gos te/ /gang du gnas na snang shas 'phel 'gyur zhing / /rang rgyud rnyed bkur zhags pas 'ching byed la/ /gzhan rgyud phrag dog 'dran sems kyis gdungs pa'i/ /gnas der skad gcig tsam yang mi gnas so/ /gzhan gyi nyes pa nam yang mi gleng zhing / /don dang ldan zhing chos mthun ma rtogs pa/ /dmag dang chom rkun rgyal po'i gtam la sogs/ /'khrul pa'i bka' mchid nam yang mi byed do/ /zhes gsungs/ sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la/ /ser snas chos nor mi ster dang / /zhes pa'i nyes pas ma gos te/

/chos don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya mgon med pa rnams la slob dpon gyi dpe mkhyud spangs te/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa rang nam tshim bar du ston pa'i phyir ro/ /gdul bya rdzas don du gnyer ba mgon med pa rnams la yang rdzas la ser sna spangs te/ dbul 'phongs kyi re ba skong bar mdzad do/ /de ltar yang bdag nyid chen po 'di mang yul skyid grong na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ zhabs tog pa med pa la/ 'jo pho phad pad gcig 'ongs nas/ bsod snyoms drag pa gcig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ nang du gshegs nas tsam rkyal dkog se ba gcig gnang bas/ sha gcig kyang thugs la thogs zer ba la/ ba sha lag pa gcig gnang / sku byug gi chas ka mar gcig kyang gnang ba zhu zer nas btsal bas mar gong phyed shags gcig rnyed pa'ang gnang / ras lcags 'ga' yar yang gnang zhes grags/ dga' ba gdong du khams pa gcig gis ja la gdan drangs/ bsngo rten gos chen 'gang dkar po gcig phul/ tshul byon pa'i lam du sprang po gcig gis gnang sbyin zhus pas/ phyag phyi btsun chung gcig yod pa la gos yug de byin gsung nas gnang / yang lha sar gshegs pa'i lam du sprang po gnyis la dngul gyi rdo rje re re gnang / lha sar sprang po mang po 'dus nas gnang byin zhus pas nye 'khor na yod pa'i sprang po rnams bos shig gsungs nas kho pas lha sa sde bzhi'i sprang po thams cad bsdus nas/ sprang rdzus dang bcas pa lnga brgya tsam byung ba la dar kha dang gos kha 'dres ma spungs nas sprang po 'phrang la bshar te/ snga gang zin re gnang bas/ sprang po rgad po gcig na re/ lha sar bla ma bzang zer ba mang po byung ste/ 'bar ba pa dang / 'di gnyis pas grag pa la byung / 'bar ba pas rin brgyan dar kha/ dar kha re'i thag bkye/ 'dis rang re bsod de kha la/ gos kha dar kha gang zin re byung zer ro/ /bul rong du bzhugs dus/ ko dkar gyi sha phyed gang za la bzhag mar gong gcig bya rog 'ga' res gang 'thor la bzhag pa sogs rdzas la ser sna mi mnga' ba yin te/

bdog pa la bdag gir 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ gser dngul gos dar sogs ci phul yang spyan gzigs pa tsam ma gtogs gces spras su 'dzin pa'i phyag len dang / zhal lta sogs gang yang mi mdzad do/ /gzhan gyi bshad kyang mi nyan par/ khros pas gzhan la 'tshog pa dang / zhes pa'i nyes pa yang mi mnga' te/ bdag nyid chen po gtsang du gshegs shul du/ chos rje rnam gnyis ra sgreng du byon dus/ nyin gcig ja gral du chos rje lo ts+tsha bas chos rje blo bzang pa la/ khyed yab sras gnyis kyi 'dir zla ba gsum du sku mtshams mdzad nas/ chos kyi 'brel gtam mang du mdzad yod par gda'/ drung rje btsun pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan ci mnga' gsung gi gda' zhus pas/ bla ma'i yon tan mkhas btsun bzang gsum la chos mthun gyi rgol ba dang bral ba der gda' zhus/ de 'dra ma yin pa'i thun mong min pa'i 'dra gsungs bdog pas/ da lan cis kyang gsung par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i yon tan chung shos su gda' lags na'ang / sa skya nas 'chad nyan bshol te bul rong du zhal log gzigs nas tha ma da lta'i bar la khong khro tsha 'khrug pa gcig kyang skye ma myong gsung gin gda' lags/ gsung nas spyan chab cher g.yos pas/ chos rje lo ts+tsha bas kyang spyan chab btang nas gsung bton te bshums zhes thos/ theg pa chen po spong byed cing / /dam chos 'drar snang ston pa 'o/ /zhes pa'i nyes pa mi mnga' ste/ theg pa chen po dbu sems gnyis/ rdo rje theg pa dang bcas pa phyin ci ma log par dgongs shing bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /nyon mongs lam du bsgyur ba rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa la'ang nyes ltung gis ma reg ste/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi brgyad rnams kyis phal cher ma gos shing / re re tsam byung srid na'ang dus las ma 'das par bshags sdom mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /theg chen bslab pa'i bsam sbyor nyams pa med/ ces so/ /sku'i spyod pa ma bcos pa yin te/

tshul 'chos dang bral/ gsung gi spyod pa ma bcos pa yin te/ gzhogs slong kha zag thob 'byol sogs dang bral/ thugs kyi spyod pa ma bcos rnam g.yeng g.yo rgyu sogs dang bral zhing / gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa rang sar zhig nas/ khyab gdal lhug pa'i spyod pa mdzad do/ /tshe 'di blos btang sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ /bden bzhi rten 'brel phyin drug rim gnyis sgom/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /nyams len rnam dag khyod la phyags 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ kho bo dben pa brten pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / 'khor dang grogs kyis yid sun phyung ba'am rnyed bkur grags pa 'dod pa'i phyir ma yin gyi/ gzhan du na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal me'i 'obs ltar shin tu brnag dka' bar mthong ba'i phyir/ de yang 'di ltar/ srid pa'i phun tshogs shin tu mnog chung zhing / /rab mang nyes pa'i tshogs dang ldan rig nas/ /rang gzhan srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir/ /mang thos bdag ni dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /char 'dod byi 'us 'brug sgra thos pa ltar/ /dben pa'i gtam 'di kho bo'i snying la 'bab/ /thos pa'i don rnams don yod bya ba'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /ngang pa'i tshogs kyis pad+mo'i mtsho mthong ltar/ /bas mtha'i gnas la kho bo sems rab g.yo/ /dal 'byor lus la snying po blang ba'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /bung ba gzhon nus 'dab brgya'i tshal mthong ltar/ /kho bo'i yid ni dben pa'i ro la chags/ /ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i ro de myang bya'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /dpyid dus bsil ba'i ma la ya rlung ltar/ /nags kyi sman ljongs kho bo'i yid la 'bab/ /nyon mongs bdud kyi sde de gzhom bya'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /gsungs nas de'i dus su/ sa skya'i brgya dpon dang bzang ldan gyi mkhan po sogs mdzad pa'i zhu ba phul na yang /

mi lo bco brgyad kyi bar du bstan pa bsam 'chad nyan byas nas da rgas kha 'dir sde gog gcig la mi 'jug gsungs te/ 'jig rten 'dren pa lha mi'i ston pa yi/ /'dod la zhen pa phung krol rtsa bar bstan/ /'dod pa'i yon tan sdug bsngal bskyed pa ste/ /nad dang 'bras dang zug rngu'i rtsa ba yin/ /ji ltar mdze can g.yan pa 'phrug pa dang / /tsha ba'i nad can bsil ba'i chu dang ni/ /skom pa'i nyen pa ba tshwa'i chu 'thungs bzhin/ /'dod pa bsten pas nam yang ngoms mi 'gyur/ /dug dang bcas pa'i g.yos legs kha zas dang / /spu gri'i so la chags pa'i sbrang rtsi dang / /shing rta 'dren pa'i phyugs kyis rtswa zos bzhin/ /'dod pa'i yon tan mnog chung nyes pa mang / /glang chen dri la chags pa'i sbrang bu dang / /rngon pa'i glu dbyangs nyan pa'i ri dwags dang / /lcags kyu'i sha la chags pa'i nya bzhin du/ /'dod la rkam pa'i byis pa myur du brlag /ces so/ /de ltar klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor los bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad nas/ spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor los bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir/ sku tshe 'di'i phun tshogs thams cad spangs te/ gangs bu le dkar po'i g.yas mgul/ g.yu lung rdo rje rdzong gi dben gnas su sgrub pa la byon nas/ lo lnga'i bar du rtse gcig sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ gang zag gi bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa nyan thos kyi lam bden bzhi mi rtag sogs skad cig ma bcu drug bsgoms/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa rang rgyal gyi lam rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog du bsgoms/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa byang sems kyi lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug 'khor gsum rnam dag tu bsgoms/ nyon mongs pa lam du bsgyur ba rig 'dzin gyi lam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bsgoms pas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rnyed pa yin te/

rnal 'byor rdo rje'i sku la rtag zhugs pa/ /ting 'dzin yongs su rdzogs pa'i yan lag te/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod do/ /bde bshegs rnams kyi dbang mchog bzhi par grags/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'ang de yin no/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub dam pa thob/ /ces gsungs/ de dus su gangs can gyi bshad sgrub kun gyis ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtog pa dang / the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs thams cad gcod pa'i gnas dam par gyur cing / kun mkhyen bzhin du dri ba kun gyi lan 'debs par mdzad do/ /thugs dam zab mo gnad du bsnun pa'i rtags/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs/ /rgyun du gzigs kyang rang rgyal brtul zhugs brten/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni gong du bstan pa'i thugs dam zab mo de dag gi nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'da' ba'i tshe dag pa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzigs kyang / rang rgyal bzhin du mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs bsten par mdzad do/ /'ga' yar gyi drung pas thugs dam mdzad pa la rtags khyad par can ci byung lags zhus pas/ mi tshe chos la bskyal ba la rtags than thun yod srid de mi bshad/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba chung ngu re la'ang gsang nas bsgrubs na 'grub kyin 'dug pa/ rtags rnams bshad na nyams par 'gyur zhing mkha' 'gro yang mi mnyes par 'dug gsungs nas/ ched du gnyer nas zhus pa phal cher mi gsungs/ yengs ma ngang la thol gsungs pa dang / dben par nan gyis yang yang zhus pa la gsungs pa re tsam bdag gis thos pa 'di ltar lags/ bu ler bla ma rgyal bzang pas/ mkhan chen g.yag pa'i gsungs nas/ slob dpon chen po gzhon blo pa'i dbu ma la'ang rgyud pa'i bla ma med/ nga yang slob dpon med rung ston gsungs pa dang / la la na re zla grags kyi sku'i skye ba yin/ la la na re zla grags la dngos su chos gsan zer ba rnams gang lags zhus pas/

dbu ma'i tshig gi rgyud pa ni yod/ don gyi rgyud pa yod pa de dka' mor 'dug dpal ldan zla ba'i skye ba min par thag chod/ chos nyan ma nyan dpon slob nang byan chud cing / mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa yod na drag med na log lta skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur gsungs/ bdag gis drung pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa ci ston yang yon tan du mthong ba ma rtogs skyon du mi rtog pa mchis pas/ cis kyang gsung bar zhu zhus pas yug gcig ci yang mi gsung bar 'dug yengs ma ngang la dpal ldan zla ba rig 'dzin gyi go 'phangs brnyes nas/ deng sang yang rgya gar na bzhugs yod pa yin/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa la khong gi drung rang du snyeg dgos pa ma yi+in gsungs pa dang / bla ma lha pas phyag rdor grub thob tu mi rkang btsugs btang nas slob dpon gzhon blo dang / byang pa 'jam dbyangs kyis gcig gis lta log bdag rkyen byas gcig gis lta log dar rgyas su byas pa 'di phyi ma gar skye gsang bdag la zhu rogs zhu byas pas/ phyag rdor grub thob kyi gsang bdag la zhus pa'i lan la/ slob dpon gzhon blo pa theg pa chen po'i gang zag khyad par can yin/ khong gi lta ba de yang zla grags kyis rmi lam du bstan pa yin gsungs/ 'jam dbyangs pa 'di sa paṇa gyi dngos slob mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa gcig yin/ da lta longs spyod dang ldan pa yang sa paṇa la tshogs 'khor gcig zhus pa'i rnam smin yin zer ba'i lan khyer 'ongs pas/ lha pa na re/ de ka yin phyag rdor kyi grub thob gcig yod na nga'i rna bar thos rtogs med zer do/ /de'i lo rgyus bdag nyid chen po la blo bzang rtser zhus pas/ khong gi yid la nga dmyal bar skye ba 'dug gsung ba gcig 'ong du re ba yin te/ de rang mi 'ong mchi gsungs/ bla ma lha pa drung pa la yang yang bskur pa 'debs pa la/ khong rang gi sgrub pa mo rgan mo gcig na re/

slob dpon gzhon blo pa la de tsam ma skyon mdzod/ khong gangs kyi mgul spang stings gcig na chos gsung gi 'dug pas/ chos nyan mkhan bsam gyis mi khyab cing / ri thams cad kyang khong gi phyogs su mgo bo btud nas nyan kyi gda' lags zhus pas/ mi tshe sgrub pa la phyin pa'i nyams kyi khams tshul lam/ de ka bden ngo shes zer ro/ /yang bul rong du bzhugs dus/ zhabs skor mdzad 'phro la kho de brag kha ya gi na sgrol ma gcig bzhugs kyin 'dug gsungs/ gang na gda' lags zhus pas/ phyag mdzub gtsug nas ya gi na gsungs/ mi gda' lags zhus pas/ de ka yin gsung / dmu rdzing du gsang 'dus kyi rgyud gsungs dus/ sgrub chen ma dpal mo'i dbon mo sgrub chung ma yang nyan gyin yod pa chos thun gyi mgo zug nas/ grol grol bar rgyun du rgod pa thengs 'ga' yar byung / rjes su khyed rgod pa ci yin byas pas/ mkha' 'gro'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha dog dang rgyan dang gos dang spyod tshul mi 'dra ba du ma chos nyan du byung ba la rgod pa yin zer ro/ /chos rje blo bzang pa dpon slob 'o de gung rgyal gyi gangs la bzhugs dus/ dgongs mo thun gtor la tshogs par rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgyal mtshos nam mkha' la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mang du 'dus nas bstod pa 'di 'don gyi 'dug pa gzigs/ gangs bu le dkar po'i shar mgul na/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug red mda' ba/ mtha' bral gyi dbu ma thugs su chud/ dmigs med kyi thugs rje rgyun chad med/ rgyud sde'i mthar thug dpal gsang 'dus/ thun mong ma yin klu sgrub lugs/ /ji bzhin gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa can/ /'gro ba'i 'dren mchog khyed la 'dud/ /ces so/ /bul rong du bzhugs dus mi nag po chud se ba gdong pa bzhi yod pa gcig gtor ma len du byung ba la/ khyed gang nas 'ongs byas pas/ ti se nas 'ongs zer/ zhal bzhi pa yin par grags so/ /nye gnas mchog legs la mdang chos skyong chung ba de 'ongs 'dug pas/

gtor ma 'bags 'dug zer/ da man chad ma 'bags pa gyis gsungs pa dang / mdang pu ṭa de 'ongs nas kha la ldags ldags nas so sod ma bcug gsungs/ dmu rdzing du rgyud mchod byas dus/ sgrub chung mas gzigs pas/ bdag nyid chen po'i mgul nas 'jig rten dbang phyug mas 'khyud de thod pa sha lnga bdud rtse lngas gang ba/ drung pa la yang zhu khong rang yang gsol kyin 'dug zer/ bul rong du tshogs 'khor gcig gis dus su/ bla ma sgrub pa dpal/ slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ bdag dang gsum yod pa la drung gi gsungs nas/ nga'i yid la da rang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnal ma med bsams na'ang / bu rgyud mgo 'chad nas ma grol kyi bar/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ma dre'u'i rmig pa zad zad bskor ba byed pa sgrub chung ma des mthong zer gyi 'dug da dung yang bstan pa a do yang yod par 'dug gsungs/ bul rong du lta khrid kyi gsol 'debs mdzad dus mtshan mo bud med dkar mo gsum 'ongs nas gsol 'debs de la lkog 'di 'dra gcig mdzad par zhu zer nas khong rnams kyi lkog 'di blangs so/ /yang bul rong du sgrub chung ma la rim lnga'i dmigs pa zhag bcu gsum tsam nas re re 'bogs kyin yod pa la/ dmigs pa gcig zhag gnyis tsam las pa la/ mi gzhon gos dkar po gyon pa gcig 'ongs nas/ chu chu me me gtong tshod ma skol ba sogs g.yog gang dgos byed cing / gtam mi zer ba gcig byung / sgrub chung mas kyang ye ma lab/ dmigs pa zhu ru phyin dus zhag gnyis tsam gyi gong du mi gzhon de 'ongs pa'i lo rgyus zhus nas/ ci lags sam zhus pas/ ci yin mi shes khyed rang yang dge sbyor la 'bungs/ ngas kyang dmigs pa bzung gis gsungs/ log nas phyin pas da rung mi de sngar bzhin g.yog gang dgos byed cing 'dug zhag bcu gcig song ba dang / nga 'gro 'dod pa yin te/ khyod kyi bla mas lung pa mes bkang nas 'gro sa mi 'dug bla ma la thugs dam blod zer ba zhu rogs gyis zer ba la/

lan ci yang ma byas/ yang dmigs pa zhu ru phyin dus khyed kyi mi de da dung yang 'dug gam gsungs/ kho zer tshul zhus pas/ ngas thugs dam tsam cher byas pa med/ da kho rang 'gro 'ong gsungs/ drung nas srung 'khor bshig pas/ log phyin dus song nas mi 'dug dpe dkar bar chad la 'ongs bar 'dug gsungs/ brag dkar rta sor bzhugs dus yang / dpe dkar gyi gzugs dgon pa'i khong khengs pa gcig byung nas/ drung pa la mig ngan lta yin 'dug thugs dam la bzhugs pas rang yal la song / bul rong du bzhugs dus/ slob dpon nam mkha' dpal bas/ zhu yig phul bas/ mnga' ris pa'i mnga' bdag de grongs zhes sgrogs kyi gda' lags pas/ thugs dam la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ de'i nub dmigs nas gsang 'dus kyi sgrub mchod gcig mdzad/ nam langs pa dang / mnga' bdag pa gnas po cher skyel ma la byon pa'i cha lugs ji lta ba bzhin sku mdun du byung bas/ drung nas yengs ma ngang la khyed grongs 'dug zer ba e bden gsungs pas/ dbu khug pa gsum mdzad nas bzhugs khri la thim song gsungs/ yang chos rje dz+nya na ba grongs dus kyang / bla ma dz+nya na ba de mdang 'dir byon byung ste/ sku gshegs pa 'dra gsungs/ dus tshod sgrigs pas de'i nub dang 'grig par byung / snyung drag po gcig byung dus thugs dam la bzhugs kyang / snyung zug ches pas sku phar 'phar ba dang / dngul chu chu ltar 'brub pa byung dus/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ /chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa/ /tha dad don min don gcig min/ /spros pa nyer zhir zhi ston pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa lan gsum gsungs pas/ snyung ba sangs dngas pa byung / bla ma sgrub pa dpal bas zhabs tog mdzad dus/ rug pa thur gshegs pas dus phyis te ma sleb pas gdan yol bar 'dug dgongs nas khong pa rang gis bshos g.yod cing yod pa la bla mas phebs kyang nang du 'gro ma nus par sgo gseng nas gzigs pas/

bshos dkrug nas sku mdun du phog ste/ chos thams cad ming tsam brda tsam tha snyad tsam btags pa tsam mo gsung nas/ bshos khru'i nang nas ka gsol kyi 'dug pas/ khong shin tu dad par gyur to/ /sa skyar mang ja gcig la dung ma byung bar byon te btso thab kyi 'gram du bzhugs nas grom chu la spyan ha re gzigs te/ spyan chab na ra ra 'dug ja gsol myangs kyang ma chad nang du log byon dus kyang ma chad par phebs pa dang / spre bo thar bzang gis khyed kyi slob dpon de za yin kyang ngu / 'gro yin kyang ngu ba ci yin zer gda'/ bdag gi snang ba la nya sram gyis za ba gzigs nas/ spyan chab byung ba yin nam snyam ste ci lags zhus pas/ de yang ma yin/ grom chu khro lo lo 'gro ba de la/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gcig sgoms pas/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba rnal ma gcig skyes byung / stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can du 'dug pas mchi ma byung ba yin gsungs/ shangs su chos bar la byon pa'i dus su drung pa la chibs gcig yod pas bshol nas byon grwa pa rnams kyi sngon la phyin nas rab la rgal/ drung pas rta gang 'gro la btang nas/ 'khor lo zab mo gcig la chud 'dug pa la/ grwa pa rnams kyi rgyugs ku co byas kyang / rta thad ka la btang bas chu la thugs ka tsam man chad nus pa byung rung / lta stangs kyang ma shor bar 'dug de 'dra'i mdzad lugs zhus pas/ rta kho rkang lag bzhi btsugs pa gcig mi 'gyel bar 'dug gsung / gzhan yang chos bar la gshegs dus/ sa cha yangs pa rnams su thugs dam la yengs nas zhal gang tshugs su gshegs te/ spyan 'dren du 'gro dgos pa yang du byung zer/ mnga' ris nas chos rje grags pa'i phyag phyi mdzad de gtsang po la byon dus kyang / thugs dam la 'byams nas chibs pas yang yang skyur zhabs tog bya dgos mang du byung bas/ rta rdzi na re/ slob dpon gzhon blo ba'i mi dgos pa'i sgom 'dis/ nga sdug rir gsod pa 'dug ces zer/
