shel dkar gyi 'du khang du gzims shing spyi khang gi stengs na gdan gsol pa mdzad kyin yod pa la/ nyin gcig bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi dus mchod gcig zhus dus mi drug bdun gcig spyi khang na yod pas/ ma mthong bar drung pa steng na phebs 'dug khang pa dog mo 'dir 'u rog gi bas ma mthong bar drung pa phebs pas rdzu 'phrul yin nam zhes ngo mtshar du gyur/ drung nas dbus la byon pa'i dus su/ chos rje pa dpon slob sum brgya tsam gyis ser phreng gis bsus/ chos rje pas phyag phul ba la phyag lan mdzad bzhed pas mi mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ de man chad phyag lan ma mdzad pas dbus pa'i dge bshes chen po rnams kyang / phyag lan zhu ba'i spros pa dang bral bar 'dra byung kyang / drung nas gsang ste'i mkhan po stag lung lo ts+tsha ba sogs la phyag phar mdzad pas jo bo bzang ba'i grags pa yang cher thob bo/ /de nas dga' ba gdong du chos rje blo bzang bas gtso mdzad/ bka' bcu pa nam mkha' byang chad/ bsod she/ dar ma/ bka' brgyad pa 'ga' yar dang / phar tshad mkhyen pa lnga brgya tsam la dbu ma 'jug pa dang / lta khrid gsungs pas/ lo tog gi char babs thams cad shin tu gus par gyur to/ /de dus gsang phu ba ldan ma dkon seng langs te/ chos rje yab sras gnyis la zhu ba re yod pas gsan du gsol/ gtsang na mkhas pa red mda' ba/ dbus na mkhas pa blo bzang pa zer nas/ khyed yab sras gnyis deng sang dbus gtsang gi bstan pa'i bdag por grags gda' bas/ da lta zhal 'dzom dus 'dir theg pa gsum grub mtha' bzhi'i bshad ral mdzad pa rnams lkog tu mi mdzad par/ bdag cag dbus gtsang gi don gnyer ba rnams kyi log rtog dang the tshom bsal ba'i phyir/ tshogs su 'bel gtam dang lung rigs kyi dgag sgrub mdzad nas kho thag chod pa'i chos 'khor yun ring du skor bar zhu ba dang / de nas yang rje btsun chen po yang bu la'i gangs la gshegs mi gsung zhing / chos rje blo bzang pa yang 'o de gung rgyal kyang gangs la mi gshags par/

dbus gtsang gi gzhung du bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad du gsol zhus so/ /de dus drung nas dge 'dun rnams la mang ja dang 'gyed dang bcas pa mdzad do/ /de nas sne'ur byon dus yab sras gnyis kyis gtso mdzad dge bshes bzang la rags pa bdun cu tsam gyis tshogs gral du gsang phu'i dge bshes gcig langs nas/ khyed yab sras gnyis la zhu ba re yod pas mi 'chab par gsong por gsung bar zhu/ bla ma rje btsun pa'i gsungs nas/ spyir bka' bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa/ gzhung lugs mgo mjug gi dgongs pa go ba re dgos pa yin/ tshig gi phreng ba re bltas te des rang la nges pa tsam med gsung ba e bden zhus pas/ ngas de 'dra rang byas su ma tshor/ lar de 'dra gcig 'dug pa gsungs pas/ bla ma'i gsungs nas don gyi zhal gyi bzhes par gda' bas/ mi 'chab par gsungs ba thugs la btags zer/ bla ma rin po che'i gsungs nas/ gzhung lugs kyi 'gangs bshog na/ nga'i bla ma dgos pa yin/ dka' ba'i gnas kyi tshig gi spu ris 'byed na a po rgan chen dgos pa yin gsung ba e bden zhus pas/ chos rje pas zhal 'dzum mdzad nas cang mi gsungs ba la/ khong na re/ yab sras gnyis kyang jo bo bzang ngan mchod rten gyi bang rim ltar log ge 'dug zer ro/ /yang sne'u'i tsha gral gcig du/ slob dpon gnyal pa zer ba gsang phu'i gling stod kyi gdan sa byed rgyu grwa pa brgya tsam yod pa gcig gis zhabs dbang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ khyed 'dra ba'i dge bshes chen po la de 'dra gar 'ong gsung nas ma gnang bas/ nga yang tshe gzhug 'dir dpal ldan red mda' pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gtugs zer ba gcig 'dod pa yin/ btsun rgan rang 'jigs mi dgos rkang pa zhog zhus pas/ 'o na ya gsungs nas zhabs dbang mdzad do/ /de nas lha sar byon nas dge 'dun brgyad brgya/ mi nag pa drug brgya tsam la skyid sdug lam khrid gcig gsungs/

de dus chos rje blo bzang pas/ jo bo'i drung du mchod pa rgya chen po bshams te/ bla ma jo bo'i drung du bzhugs te/ smon lam gyi mthun 'gyur mdzad du gsol zhus nas/ khong pa rang gis gtso mdzad dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam gyis yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa gcig phul/ gtso bor bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang / khong pa rang gis mdzad pa'i bde ba can gyi smon lam sogs rgya cher btab/ khyad par du rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa ku ma ra ma tis gtso mdzad bstan pa'i rtsa lag skyes chen dam pa zhal bzhugs pa thams cad bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du zhabs pad brtan par gyur cig ces pa lan gsum mdzod do/ /de dus drung nas zhabs dbang su zhu zhu la gnang / chos rje pas ye ma gnang bas gsang phu ba'i gra pa rnams na re/ red mda' ba khong 'chi bas mi 'jigs pas zhabs dbang su zhu zhu la gnang gi 'dug blo bzang pa 'chi bas 'jigs nas su la yang mi gnang 'dug zer ba byung / de nas ra sgreng la 'byon dus/ brag dkar lo pa/ bya yul rin po che/ lo mkhan po/ 'bri gung pa'i stag rtse rdzong pa rnams kyi 'bul nod phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ de nas stag rtse phu la byon pas/ dge 'dun sum brgya tsam gyi gdan chad nas/ kun bsod snyoms la byon pa dang / gdan thebs tsam byung / de nas lo pa'i tshogs pa chos 'brel zhur byung ste/ tsam pa mdzo rgyab nyi shu lhag tsam phul bas slar mi theg pa'i sdug bsngal du gyur/ chos rje yab sras nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa 'dra zer ba'i grags pa byung / de nas ra sgreng du phyags phebs/ dngul gdugs can che chung gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyis gtso mdzad rten gsum ngo mtshar ba rnams la phyag dang mchod pa rgya cher phul nas dgon pa gong du yab sras gnyis sku mtshams bcad pa'i bug sgo nas/ gzhi byes kyi tshogs pa drug brgya tsam la skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor tshul ni/

bdag nyid chen pos nyams len byin rlabs kyi khrid/ gsang 'dus rim lnga zab mo lta ba'i khrid/ bdag med gnyis sgom tshul rgya chen spyod pa'i khrid/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong dang bzhi brgya pa'i bshad pa rnams gnang mtshams grol nas rig pa bcu drug pa'i bshad pa rgyas pa gcig gnang nas/ grol dus kho bo klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa 'chad na de ltar 'chad pa yin/ mi re re'i rtog pa dang bstun nas gzhung lugs 'chad pa kun mkhyen gyis kyang dka' gsungs/ chos rje pa 'bri gung du byon shul bka' bcu pa gnyis kyis gtso mdzad/ gsang bde gung gsum rtse thang sogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag pa bdun cu tsam la gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa/ dbu ma rgyan gyi bshad pa rgyas pa gcig gnang bas ldan ma dkon seng dang / nam mkha' gu dog ral la sogs pa cung mi dad pa rnams kyang mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par gyur to/ /de nas yab sras gnyis stag lung gi mdor zhal 'dzom dus 'ol ka stag rtse ba'i jo mo chos 'brel zhu bar 'ongs pa gcig la chos smyo byung ba la/ drung gi gsung nas dge 'dun gcig rgyug la jo mo ma gi'i lag pa g.yas pa 'og tu zhog la/ khyed kyi lag pa g.yas pas steng nas rgyob dang gsung pa la/ de bzhin byas pas jo mo smyo ba sangs/ 'khor phal mo che'i bsam pa la 'di sde snod la mkhas pa min pa gegs sel sogs mi mkhyen snyam pa yod pa la/ kun ngo mtshar che bar gyur to/ /de nas stag lung du spyan drangs te/ stag lung rin po ches na bza' chibs pa ja sig sogs 'bul nod rgya chen po mdzad/ tshogs pas tshogs chos zhus stag lung pa kun gus par gyur to/ /de nas gnam rtse ldeng gi gtsug lag khang du/ chos rje lo ts+tsha ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang po dang / chos rje yab sras gnyis kyi gtso mdzad dbyar gnas khas blangs pa'i dge 'dun lnga brgya/ phyogs bcu nas chos 'brel la 'dus pa rnams dang bcas pa brgyad brgya tsam byung ba la chos kyi 'khor lo skor tshul ni/

bdag nyid chen pos gung chos la 'dul ba/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug gnyis/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud/ lta khrid rnams gnang / gzhan yang phyogs nas byon pa rnams la chos 'brel ci 'dod gnang / de dus chos rje blo bzang pas dbyar gnas rgyags gang byung gi dngos po drag pa rnams 'bul ba'i dam bca' mdzad nas gser srang re re'i maṇ+ḍal thengs gsum phul/ gzhan yang dngos po byung res bzhin gyi spyan drangs nas khong pa rang gis 'bul ba 'bul smon lam 'debs/ bsngo ba zhu ba sogs mdzad cing / de gong du yang gser gar lugs dang li sku'i 'jam dbyangs zhal gnyis kyi gtso mdzad/ gser dngul gos dar sogs 'bul nod rgya chen po mdzad cing / rjes su yang dngul bro chen/ na bza' cha tshang thengs 'ga' yar dang gsol ja rgyun mi 'chad par phul nas/ rtag tu ngus chos 'phags bsten pa bzhin mdzod/ dbyar gnas grol ba dang gtsang du byon nas/ sa skyar phyags phebs te 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du ta 'un gyi snam sbyar bzang po gcig dang bla re gcig phul/ tshogs pa bstod skor brgyad brgya tsam la mang ja 'gyed dang bcas pa mdzad/ de nas bul rong du sku mtshams la lo gsum dam po bzhugs dus/ bu le rgyun du gtor ma len du 'ong gi yod pa nyin gcig sgrub chung mas kyang mthong nas rgod pas/ ci 'dug gsung / kho bu le gtor ma len du 'ongs gda' zer/ dang po dmu rdzing du chos bar mdzad dus/ nam langs pa dang / gzhi bdag lo khyung lung la sku mdun la yar rtol nas/ rgyan dang cha lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa phyag 'tshal byin rlabs zhus nas sa la thim song / snga dro tsha dus gzhi bdag mo'i gzugs gyang ngos la bris pa gcig gzigs pas/ mo 'di 'dra gcig mi 'dug 'di bas brgya 'gyur gyis mdzes pa gcig 'dug gsungs/ de dus bud med gcig la gzhi bdag mo babs nas/ sngon gyi dge slong de tsho phebs pas zhabs tog yang dag pa phul zer/

sngon gyi dge slong ni byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ de dus mkhan chen dpal 'byor/ slob dpon dar ma sogs lnga la mdzod kyi rang 'grel gyi steng nas mdzub khrid mdzad pas lnga kas mdzod dga' mo shes pa re byung / 'di 'dra'i 'chad nyan drod po yin/ zhes mnyes tshor chen po mdzad do/ /ngam rings rtse mo blo bzang ba sogs dpon slob bcu drug gis chos bar mdzad dus/ ngam rings shod na mkhan chen bstan rgyal ba dpon slob bdun brgya tsam 'chad nyan mdzad kyis 'dug pas/ drung pa'i thugs dgongs la khong dpon slob bdun brgya po dang / nged bcu drug po bstan pa la su phan che'am dgongs pa gcig byung / dus phyis khong bdun brgya pos blo bzang grags pa gcig yang mi do bar 'dug gsungs/ dang po bu ston rin po che'i sras kyi thu bo mkhan chen dharma shrī dpon slob lnga bcu tsam bka' bzhi la 'chad nyan yang dag pa mdzad pa gzigs pas ngas kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs 'di tsam 'ong ba gcig byung na dgongs pa byung ba la/ dus phyis bstan pa dang sems can la khong pa bas dngos phan che ba gcig byung 'dug gsungs/ khri rgyal bsod nams lde bas/ 'phags pa thogs med sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i skyes bu chen por 'dug pa la/ rje btsun byams pas dbu ma mi ston pa ci lags zhus/ 'o na a ma tshos bu tsha la dang po sbrus dgong rdzis nas mi gter bar lha ga ster ba ci yin gsungs/ lan zhu ba'i spobs pa dang bral lo/ /yang longs sprul sangs rgyas min zer mkhan mang po gda' lags pas/ ji ltar lags zhus pas/ deng sang gi mkhas pa 'di rnams la nges pa tsam mi 'dug ngas dur khrod rgyud 'grel la 'gal 'du yod byas pa la chos spong gi las yin zer 'dug longs sprul sangs rgyas min zer mkhan byung rung / de 'dra'i lugs kyang yod zer nas ci ru yang mi bsgom pa 'dug ste/ longs sprul sangs rgyas min na mdo rgyud thams cad bka' min par 'gyur ba la sogs pa nyes pa shin tu che gsungs/

gnas brtan dngos grub na re/ 'u'i bla ma 'di kun spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dug blun po gcig dang sdongs dang / de bas ca drag tsam/ phar tshad shes pa gcig dang sdongs snyam de bas ca drag tsam/ bka' bzhi mkhyen pa gcig dang sdongs kyang de bas ca drag tsam/ mkhas pa chen po gcig dang sdongs kyang de bas che ba mngon par mtho bar mdzad kyi 'dug nga ni lhag par de rang la mos pa gcig byung zer/ bka' bcu pa yon tan na re/ ngas bla ma 'di bas dkon mchog la dad gus che ba ma mthong / skyid grong jo bo la 'jal res kyi jo bo'i phyag la 'jus nas/ spyan ras gzigs dbang khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /zhes sogs kyi sh+lo ka 'don gyin spyan chab khral khral 'ong gi 'dug zer/ de e bden snyam nas dus phyis ched du gnyer nas bdag gis kyang bltas pas bden par gda' 'o/ /gsang phu ba'i slob dpon rgyal dbang na re/ ngas bla ma su bya ba'i rtsa bar bsdad de/ sdug bsngal rang 'gags la 'gro ba red mda' ba min pa ma mthong zer/ 'jam dbyangs pa na re/ 'ga' zhig da lta bod na slob dpon bas mkhas pa med zer na'ang / nga'i lugs kyi rgya gar shar nub/ rgya nag bal po rnams na bstan pa rnal ma med par 'dug pas/ da lta 'dzam bu'i gling na slob dpon mkhas pa bas mkhas pa med par go gsungs/ drung nas khri skor gzhan du gshegs tsa na/ zhal du mi 'don yang thugs khral cher mdzad/ byang du phebs zer ba gsan ma khad/ shin tu gtam snyan rten gsum byin rlabs can re yod na'ang yod zer ba la de 'dra dang mnyam po min/ gzhung lugs pa chen po phyag phebs pa sa phyogs bkra shis pa yin zer nas mnyes tshor chen po mdzad do/ /mkhan chen bsod nams skyabs na re/ nga'i bla ma 'di'i yon tan chung shos kyang gzhan gyi mi do/ /bla ma ni ri phug tu bzhugs kyang gos dar gyi na bza' 'phangs med la bsnoms/ gzhan sde bdag tu bya bsgom pa rnams kyang / nang du hrul chas gyon zhing phyi la 'gro dus bzob par 'dug gsungs te shin tu mad do/

/dmu rdzing du bzhugs dus bka' bcu pa don seng gis mjal du byon nas/ chos zhus/ grol ba dang 'gro ba'i grab byas pas/ khyed da ris 'gro na rta zur gyi zam pa thon tsam der rgyug gsungs/ bdag cag de phyogs la mi 'gro lags zhus pas/ a ha nga ni bul rong na yod pa'i bsam pa gcig byung 'dug gsung / bdag gis drung du phyin nas bka' bcu pa la de ltar gsungs pa lags sam zhus pas de byung nga la bul rong gi lung pa ya gi la pha yul gyi snang ba gcig 'char gyin 'dug ste/ bag chags brtas pa yin pa 'dra gsungs/ ri khrod dga' mo ya gi rnyed pa 'phags chen chos bzang dpal gyi bka' drin yin gsungs/ 'phags chen chos bzang dpal la mjal du byon dus khyed bstan pa rin po che'i bdag po yin pas/ de ltar thugs khur bzhes shig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di khyed kyi phyag na yod do/ /bstan pa rin po che 'di la khyed shes so gsungs nas phyag nas bzung zhing zhal ta mang po gnang ba'i mthar/ khyed kyis bstan pa rin po che la sngar phyag rjes bzhag pa'i rtsom pa rnams kyi dkar chag kyang 'dir khod gsung nas/ gong du bstan pa'i gsung sgros rnams dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa mar bcad lo 'di la 'di mdzad kyi dkar chag kyang mdzad do/ /drung nas grod chung du bzhugs dus skyid grong jo bo la phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu rnams tshod kyis brdung nas 'bul du btang bas/ dkrigs ran pa byung / drung nas phyag tshad mdzad pa lags sam zhus pas/ ma byas 'tshams pa jo bo rang gi thugs rje yin gsungs/ bdag gis mkhan chen g.yag pa la mjal du phyin dus/ khong pa la chos rje lots+tsha ba rje btsun pa blo bzang pa gsum gang lhag zhus pas/ slob dpon gzhon blo ba lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen deng sang dka' mo la btad yod gsung zhing / khong gi phar phyin gyi ṭī ka de la bltas pas nang 'gal 'ga' yar 'dug khong byams chos sems tsam yin gsungs na'ang /

ngas bka' ru 'dod de byams pa sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ khong gsang 'dus pa chen po yin pas/ 'jam dbyangs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor mdzad kyi yod 'ong / 'jam dbyangs dang byams pa gnyis sangs rgyas yin na yin mnyam yin/ ngas zer gyi 'dug slob dpon la zhus gcig gsungs nas zhus pas/ nang 'gal than thun yod srid/ 'khrul med smra ba'i 'phags par ngas khas blangs pa med/ khong gis nang 'gal du bzung ba rnams nang 'gal e yin mi shes/ bstan pa 'di gzhir bzhag la byams pa byang sems dang / byams chos lnga bstan bcos su bshad 'dug kho rang sangs rgyas pas lhag gsungs na'ang dbang che/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyu phar phyin theg pa la bkab rung / zhwa dpe l+h+wam la bkab pa bya ba mkhas pa'i lugs ma yin gsungs/ mkhan chen chos dpal ba'i gsungs nas 'u rang mthong lam thob thob lta ba'i gtam la zer/ de nas shes 'ong gsung zer ba drung du skyar bas/ mthong lam lta ba rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bu yin pa la lta ba ma shes par mthong lam gcig thob ngos shes kha phye na stong zad pa'i lab yin gsungs/ chos rje lo ts+tsha ba dang bla ma dbang pas gdan 'dren btang bas khams bzang zhing rten 'brel 'grig na 'ong bar zhu zhus pas/ lo ts+tsha bas dgon pa brtsigs nas khal nyis stong tsam bsags/ de'i rgyab cha'i sha mar gos stan me shing sogs bsgrubs nas/ da lam phebs pa gcig 'ong na zhes yid smon du mdzad cing gdan 'dren pa btang bas/ nged na so rgas sha lus lci bas 'grul mi pher bar 'dug gsungs nas/ thugs dam gyi gtso bo 'jam dbyangs kyi li sku mtshar po gcig zhu rten la phul nas ma byon/ drung nas thugs shes kyis mkhyen nas stag tshang du dus zings chen po 'ong ba dang / yon mchod gnyis ka'i sku tshe thung ngu las mi 'ong bar mkhyen nas ma byon par grags/ bul rong du snga rting la lo bcu gnyis bzhugs pa la lo lnga drung pa rang gi thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad/

lo bdun la chos 'khor ci rigs su bskor zhing bul rong shod du mkhan chen dpal 'byor ba chos rje mchog bzang bas gtso mdzad chos kho na don du gnyer ba'i dge 'dun sha stag brgyad cu tsam la gsang 'dus kyi rgyud/ rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum lta khrid sogs zhib rgyas su gnang / gsan mkhan rnams la yang bya rgyu chos las med pas nyin mtshan chos kho nas 'da' ba byung / sa cha bgrod dka' mo der yang sa skya tshun chad snyags nas brnyen bkur bzang la mang ba byung / bul rong du bstan pa brnyen dang bkur bstir bcas pa de bas lhag pa dus gsum du khegs zer ro/ /de'i phyi lo dmu rdzing slob dpon chen po nam mkha' dpal bas gtso mdzad/ brag ram mkhan chen/ slob dpon las ston/ 'dar pa mgon seng / sgrub chen ma dpal mo/ yon bdag dpon po rtogs ldan la sogs pa brgya brgyad cu tsam la gsang 'dus kyi rgyud/ rtsa 'jug gnyis lta khrid dang bcas pa gnang ngo / /chos sum gnyis tsam song ba dang sgrub chen mo dpal mo la nam smad mi ma yin chen po gcig dngos su 'ong nas/ khyod nam lang pa dang bla ma'i drung du rgyug la phyag gsum phul la drung nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la yun ring du bzhugs su gsol/ zhes lan gsum zhus/ bar chad chen po byung dogs 'dug go zer ba de thos pas sgrub chen ma dngangs te/ thugs mi bde ba byung / nam langs pa dang drung du zhu ba gal chen gcig yod pas cis kyang 'ong ba zhu zhus pas/ shog gsungs nas gong du zer ba bzhin phyag phul/ gsol ba btab nas 'di bdag la gyis zer mkhan gcig byung ba ma rtogs rdzun nam zog yin na drung gi bka' srung rnams kyis chad pa chod byas pas/ mna' skyel gyin khyed la brdzun zer ba'i gal med mchid/ nged sa skyar 'chad nyan byed dus lo grangs 'di tsam la 'chi zer ba'i sgra gcig byung ba yin te/ de dus brtags pa re gcig pa la 'chi ba 'dug snyam pa byung /

da lo mi 'chi sang phod skeg chen po yin pas 'chi'am snyam gyi 'dug gsungs/ drung pa la skeg chen pas bsu skeg che ba gcig gda' lags/ de dus kyi lo rta gang yin rtsi bar zhu dang zhus nas rtsis pas/ sgrub chen ma gsung ba dang gcig par byung / de nas chos grol ba dang bul rong du byon nas sku mtshams dam po gcig mdzad par zhu/ bdag gis kyang gdan bzhugs gcig la 'ong zhus nas rjes su gdan bzhugs zab mo gcig phul bas lo 'ga' yar sku khams bzang po 'ong ba'i ltas byung gsungs/ de'i phyi lo mnga' ris phyogs sa cha bzang zhing mi blo las su rung ba 'dug pas/ 'gro gsungs nas 'jam dbyangs pas rgya mkhar bar bdas pas ma non/ chen po dpal ldan pas cung thugs bdas nas zhu ba phul yang ma gsan par mnga' ris la byon/ yar res ne rings pa'i dbon po la dge tshul gyi bslab bya gnang / dpon po rtogs ldan pa la dge slong gi sdom pa gnang / khong rnam pas kyang 'bul 'degs phun sum tshogs pa mdzad nas stag rtse bas brag nag bar skyal lo/ /de nas mnga' ris pas bsus te rdzong dkar du phyag phebs/ gung thang khab pas shangs len phun sum tshogs pa mdzad do/ /de nas mang yul du byon te rang byon 'phags pa'i drung du phyag dang mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ sher pa dpon po la rab byung gi sdom pa gnang nas/ me tog mdangs can gyi nags khrod du sgrub pa la byon no/ /de dus gzhi bdag btsan rje zer ba chos la dkar po gcig yod pa 'ongs nas nga la chang gcig 'dren gyi 'dug chang mi 'thung ba la snyam pas/ mar khur song nas dum pa gcig 'thungs nas bzhag 'bul ba zangs zing mang po yang byed kyi 'dug de nas zhag bzhi lnga nas rgya'i 'bul ba des sleb byung / de gzhi bdag gi tshor ba 'dra snyam pa su byung gsungs/ de nas sku mtshams grol ba dang / bdag chen ma sangs rgyas rgyal mos bod du spyan drangs/ dpon slob rnams ri 'dabs su dbyar rgyags bteg

'bul ba yang phun sum tshogs pa phul/ de dus drung slob dpon mas gtso mdzad chen po chos dpal ba/ slob dpon yid dam dpal/ bka' bcu pa don seng la sogs pa brgya brgyad cu tsam la gsang 'dus rigs lnga/ lta khrid blo sbyong / rtsa 'jug gnyis/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud kyi bshad la sogs zab rgyas su gnang zhing / mnga' bdag sku mched/ bdag mo mched/ zhang blon 'ga' yar gsang 'dus kyi dbang gnang / dpon zhang nam mkha' stobs rgyal ba khu dbon la bsnyen rdzogs dang rab byung gi sdom pa gnang / de dus mnga' bdag yum sras pa rnams la bstan 'gyur bzhengs gsung ba'i zhal ta gnang bas/ bdag chen ma'i gsung nas/ drung nas thugs rjes bzung ba'i zhal ta yin/ bdag cag rang ci 'byor byed par zhu zhus pas/ de shin tu legs gsung nas mnyes tshor cher mdzad/ khong tshos blos ma blangs na/ paṇa chen shākya shrīs kyang bod yul gyi 'bul nod thams cad khro phu'i rgyal ba byams pa bzhengs pa la btang 'dug ngas pu rangs mar bcad 'di 'grims na bstan 'gyur 'grub tsam gyi dngos ca 'grub bsam pa byung na'ang / sde pas bzhengs pa shin tu legs gsungs nas/ bdag chen ma la dka' ru la dngul bre chen gcig gos phyi nang bzang po ma lnga/ ber thul thongs rings re re/ rgya'i rdor dril gcig gan dkar gcig rnams gnang nas bdag chen mas thugs khur cher bzhes 'bad rtsol bton pas lo gcig gi khongs su bar chad med par grub pas bla ma byin rlabs che zhing yon bdag mo sku bsod dang blo stobs che ba'i grags pa byung ngo / /de nas rab gnas la rdzong dkar spyan drangs te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phye nas sgrub mchod rgyas par mdzad pas gsung rabs zhal dro zhing byin rlabs che ba/ mchod gnas ngo dro/ yon bdag bkra shis sa phyogs byin chags pa'i rab gnas mdzad do/ /drung du gser don po srang bdun/ gos ta 'un gyi snam spom gcig gis mgo byas kyi 'bul nod rgya chen po mdzad dus/

drung gis zhal ltas bdag mo mi lus thob pa don yod bya ba de lta bu la zer ba yin/ chos la bya ba byas pa rang sangs rgyas su skye bar mdo sde du ma nas gsungs/ deng sang dbus gtsang gi sde pa su stobs che yang / snag shog glegs shing glo bur du sgrub dgos na 'byor ba shin tu dka' gsung zhing / de ltar sgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba rgya chen po yang mdzad do/ /bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa'i 'go tshugs pa tsam la/ drung nas bla ma sgrub pa dpal la bstan 'gyur 'di bar chad med par 'grub par 'dug nga'i rmi lam du dbus gtsang ba thams cad du thos pa'i dung thengs bdun bus pa rmis gsungs/ ra sgreng du bzhugs dus mtshan lam du chos rje blo bzang pa dang gnyis gzhung lam chen po gcig la sangs rgyas ru 'gro rgyu yin zer 'gro yi 'dug pas/ blo bzang pa che mgyogs byon kyi 'dug khong lam na mchod rten gcig 'dug pa la bskor ba byed cing 'dug ngas ma byas par phyin pas/ sangs rgyas sa yin zer ba'i khri chen po gcig 'dug ngas sngon la 'dzegs/ khong gis kyang de ma khad la phebs byung / khong la khyed sangs rgyas par zhu byas pas khong na re/ bla ma byang chub sngon la mdzad par zhu zer nas ngas sngon la sangs rgyas pa rmis/ khong bskor ba byed pa de bar skabs su rang don yid byed gcig byung ba yin nam snyam pa byung gsung / de la sogs pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i yon tan mtha' yas so/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi che btsun 'byor ldan gyis/ gus pas spyan drangs rnyed dang bskur stis mchod/ /dbang bskur sems bskyed gdams pa mang du zhus/ /kun gyis mchod 'os khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ rigs dang gtong ba la sogs pa mtho ris kyi yon tan gyis mngon par mtho ba 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rin chen pas/ bdag nyid chen po mkhas pa'i grags pa thob nas 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i dus su dpon slob rnams yang yang bteg

gsung sgros mang po bzhengs nas blo gsal rnams la gnang / bzhengs mkhan rnams la yang snag shog sogs chas ka mang po gnang / gsung sgros la 'chad nyan mdzad pa rnams kyi bdag rkyen yang dag pa mdzad/ bul rong du phyags phebs mar bcad kyang phyogs nas byung ba'i bya bral ba rnams bteg bkren pa rnams la ci 'dod kyi gsung sgros rnams bris nas gnang ba sogs bshad sgrub mdzad pa'i zhabs tog yang dag pa mdzad pas na sbyin bdag rnams kyi gtso bo yin no/ /rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang gis mngon par mtho ba khri rgyal bsod nams ldes yab yum gyis dpon slob gang yod lo gnyis kyi bar du bteg mnga' ris su chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bdag rkyen yang dag mdzad cing / dpon slob rnams la 'bul nod phun sum tshogs pa mdzad nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pas na sbyin bdag gi mchog yin no/ /sne pas dpon slob 'khor bcas dga' ba gdong dang ra sgreng du nam bzhugs bar bteg cing / 'bul nod rgya chen po yang mdzad/ dpon yon tan rgya mtshos gnam rtse ldeng du bzhugs rgyags/ 'khor bcas bteg cing 'bul nod phun sum tshogs pa yang mdzad do/ /gling dkar bas yar mar gyi zhabs tog 'bul nod dang bcas pa yang sgrub/ gnas rnying stong dpon rgyal mtshan bzang pos 'chad nyan mdzad dus/ dpon slob rnams kyi 'chad nyan gyi bdag rkyen yang dag par mdzad do/ /'bri gung pa chen po shes rab dpal bas nam bza' ja dkar sig chen la sogs pa 'bul nod rgya chen po sgrubs/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos kyang nas mkhal brgya phul nas dpon slob rnams bteg chu 'dus pas spyan drangs nas chos 'khor skor ba'i bdag rkyen 'bul nod yang dag mdzad/ shrī ri 'dzam bu gling du bla ma bsod nams 'od zer ba dpon slob rnams dbyar rgyags bteg nas chos 'khor skor/ mang yul seng ge mkhar du dbon po bsod nams don grub kyis dpon slob 'khor bcas zla ba gcig bteg nas chos 'khor skor/

lan lde gung sdings su bla ma 'jam dpal gleng pa lcam sring gis dpon slob sum cu tsam zla ba gsum gyi bar du bteg drung nas nam bza' sogs 'bul nod phun tshogs dang / bya bral ba rnams la yang na bza' re phul/ stag rtse bas dmu rdzing du chos 'khor skor ba'i bdag rkyen dang yar mar gyi dpon slob rnam kyis zhabs tog 'bul nod dang bcas pa mdzad/ khyad par kho rang grongs dus thugs dam 'dogs thig po zho drug cu rtsa drug 'gor ba gcig phul/ bya bral ba rnams la yang 'gyed dang bcas pa sgrubs/ drung a phi ba dang / dpon zhang kun spangs pas 'bul 'degs bzang po mdzad/ khyad par du drung slob dpon mas zhabs tog 'thil zhugs yang dag pa mdzad do/ /sher pa sku mched pas kyang zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ gzhan yang mnga' ris kyi slob rigs 'byor ldan dad pa can rnams kyi zhabs tog yang dag sgrubs/ drung nas kyang dbus gtsang gi sbyin bdag de rnams thams cad la dbang bskur/ sems bskyed lung khrid la sogs gang la gang 'os kyi chos kyi 'brel pa gnang nas dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par mdzad pas/ sangs rgyas dngos lta bu mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas gangs can gyi skye bo phal mo che'i 'dren pa dam par gyur to/ /kun mkhyen sher 'od la sogs pa mdo khams kyi bu slob rnams dang / bka' bcu pa kun dga' dpal la sogs dbus gtsang gi bu slob rnams kyis kyang 'byor pa dang bstun nas gus pas mchod do/ /gzhan yang gnam gyi mtha' ma rgya nag po'i yul nas/ ta ming rgyal pos/ gos bzang po phyi nang lnga/ snam sbyar bzang po/ sku 'gag ber thul thongs rings/ dbu theb zhabs l+h+wam/ sku skegs/ phyag phreng / rdor dril cha gnyis/ ting shag cha gnyis/ rten khebs gnyis/ gan dkar gnyis/ gsol khebs gcig maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyan gsum/ tsan+dan dkar po dum gcig ja dkar rgya ma lnga bcu rnams phul/ gu ge rgyal pos/ kha che gur gum zho lnga bcus 'go byas 'bul nod mang du byung ngo /

'brug gi lo la mya ngan 'da' dgongs nas/ go rtogs nyams su myongs ba'i zab don rnams/ /ston pas bstan pa gtong pa ji bzhin du/ /chos 'khor nan 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ mang gung gi mtshams gling rtse dpal gyi dben gnas su 'brug gi lo la dge 'dun brgya phrag phyed dang gnyis la chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i dus su/ de lo mya ngan las 'da' bar mkhyen nas/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa lnga'i bar du thos bsam sgom gsum gyis rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa zab mo phyin ci ma log pa rtogs shing / thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i don rnams ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od bsrungs chen po dang kun dga' bo sogs la/ nga'i mdo sde rin po che 'di khyed la gtad do khyed rnams kyis zungs shig chongs shig lhogs shig kun chub par gyis shig gzhan dag la yang rgya cher ston cig ces yang dang yang du gsungs pa bzhin du bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang gdul bya'i tha ma rnams la gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid/ lta khrid tshar gnyis/ 'jug pa tshar gsum btud nas gsungs/ rtsa ba tshar gcig rgyas par gsungs/ smon 'jug gi thugs bskyed lan gnyis nyin gcig la gsungs/ gsang 'dus kyi dbang thengs gnyis gnang / lce sgom rdzong pa'i man ngag rin spungs kyi lung gnang / bya bral ba rnams kyi lo mang po'i bar du gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang ba'i gsung rabs thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa bka' 'bum thor bu ba'i lung yang gnang / sngar nas gsung ba dang mi 'dra ba'i dka' ba'i gnas rnams lan gnyis lan gsum du skyar nas gsungs/ de ltar nges par gyis shig ces yang yang du gsungs shing / khyad par du 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lugs kha na ma tho ba med pa 'di la ma brten par 'tshang rgya mi nus par khas len e nus zhes chos 'go mjug la lan gnyis gsum gsungs kyang lan zhu mkhan ma byung 'dug bdag nyid chen po'i bzhed pas 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs rdo rje theg pa dang /

phar phyin theg pa gnyis las ma gsungs shing / de gnyis kyi lam gyi gtso bo yang rdzogs rim dang / lta ba rnam dag gnyis yin la/ de gnyis kyang ming tha dad kyis bstan pa tsam ma rtogs ngo bo bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kho na yin/ des rtogs pa'i gnas lugs kyi don de las gnas lugs kyi don gzhan dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs shing / de phyin ci ma log par 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bstan pa 'di kho na yin snyam du dgongs pa yin no/ /'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyi lugs las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'dzugs par mdzad pa yin no/ /dbang gnang dus dang dbu ma'i skabs 'ga' yar du spyan chab yang yang gtong ba'i rgyu mtshan ni chos dang chos smra ba'i gang zag la dad cing gus pa skyes pa'am/ ngas klu sgrub kyi lta ba zab mo 'di bstan pa dang / dad pa tsam ma rtogs phyin ci ma log par go ba tsam ma byung bar/ gdul bya la thugs chad nas/ zer lo gyis dang / go ba mi go gsung ba dang / ye gsang chen mor 'dug gi gsung zhing / zab mo lta ba'i bstan pa nub 'gro bar gzigs te thug mug nas bshums par yang go 'o/ /'khor 'das chos kun skye ba med bstan nas/ /de nyid ngang la mya ngan 'da' bzhed na'ang / /gus pas gsol btab ngo ru zhag bdun bar/ /sku tshe byin rlabs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ gang tshe skye med de nyid yin zhing blo yang skye ba dang bral ba/ /zhes pa'i skabs su yul yul can gyi bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad skye ba med par bstan te/ rang nyid kyang chos kyi dbyings su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed nas/ snyung ba'i tshul bstan na yang / gdul bya rnams kyi mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa'i ngor zhag bdun gyi bar du sku tshe byin gyis rlabs nas sku khams dwangs pa ste/ da lo'i chos 'di bar chad kyang mang ba gcig byung bas grol ba'i rigs mi 'dug gsungs nas/

rim lnga lta khrid la sogs pa'i dmigs pa gnyis gsum dkrug kyin gnang zhing 'jug pa'i bshad pa yang grol bar mdzad do/ /'chi ba 'od gsal lus la brten mi srid/ /lus sems bral nas rnam shes stong par zhugs/ /dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal yin no zhes/ /yang yang gsungs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ deng sang gi man ngag pa phal cher nyer thob mun chen gyi gnas skabs su zhi gnas kyi mthus sems lus la yun ring du gnas pa la 'chi ba 'od gsal du 'dod na'ang / de 'dra mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yin/ lus sems bral nas rnam shes stong chen chos kyi dbyings su zhugs nas dbyings rig dbyer med du gyur pa la/ 'chi ba 'od gsal zhes zer ba yin/ 'di ltar bshad na mang po gcig dgra ru 'gro ste/ 'di mi zer kha med yin pas/ thams cad kyi yid la zungs shig ces mang du gsungs so/ /sngar bsgoms 'pho ba'i man ngag gsal btab nas/ /rtags rnams ma brjed dga' spros 'od gsal 'jug /'gog la ldang zhing sngon gyis 'phen pas 'pho/ /gsung zhing mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di deng sang gi 'chi tsa na 'pho ba 'debs zer ba'i lag len gcig dar 'dug na'ang / phyi dbug ma chad pa la 'debs pa yin/ phyi dbugs chad nas btab kyang thos pa'i go skabs med/ de'ang / sngar 'pho ba'i gnad man ngag sgom myong na/ mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa la gzhan gyis 'pho ba 'debs pa yin/ man ngag ma thob pa'i skye bo tha mal pa la 'pho ba'i man ngag bstan kyang kho la ci yang mi phan/ de bas mtshan dang / gzungs byin rlabs can brjod pa don che/ man ngag dang ldan pa 'chi ba'i tshe/ sngar rang gis bsgoms pa'i 'pho ba'i man ngag rnams legs par gsal btab nas/ nga 'di 'dra gcig tu skyes na snyam pa'i 'phen pa drag tu sngon du btang nas/ 'byung ba bzhi thim pa'i rtags dang / snang ba gsum shar ba'i rtags rnams ma brjed par byas nas/

rtags rnams rdzogs pa dang / da nga 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa mngon sum du byed pa 'dug snyam pa'i dga' spro cher skye zhing / pha khyim du bu 'gro ba ltar brod pa dang bcas nas chos kyi dbyings la zhugs pa la 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byas pa zer ba yin/ de'i ngang la 'pho ba'i rnam rtog med kyang / mngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis gang 'dod pa'i skyes gnas su 'phen nus pa la 'pho ba thebs pa zer ba yin/ nyan thos rnams 'gogs pa la snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe/ zhag dang zla ba dang lo 'di tsam gyi bar du snyoms par 'jug cing / snyoms 'jug gi ngang las ldang ba'i 'du shes med kyang sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis dus las mi 'da' bar ldang ba yin/ dper na gnyid log pa'i sngon la nang par snga mor ldang mnyam pa'i 'phen pa btang nas nyal bas/ gnyid kyi ngang la ldang ba'i blo med kyang / 'phen pas snga mor gnyid sad pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsung zhing / ji ltar gsung ba bzhin du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus su yang mngon du mdzad do/ /sku tshe 'di yi dngos kyi gdul bya la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zin nas/ /'chi ba 'od gsal skabs su gzhan don gshegs/ /skye 'chi dbang thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ gong du bstan pa de ltar gyi gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par zab pa don dam bden pa dang / rgya che ba kun rdzob kyi bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i thabs chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bskor zin nas/ rang nyid mya ngan las 'da' ba la 'jigs pa dang / ya nga ba dang / bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba yin te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal gyi sgrub chen ma na re/ tshe sgrub ma mdzad na sku tshe thung zer gda' lags/ tshe sgrub mdzad na zhus pas/ drug cu kha ral gyis dus su/ drug cu rtsa lnga song 'dug da tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel mi sgrigs gsung ba dang /

snyung pa ldog pa'i snga dro bla ma rgyal bzang gis phyag phul nas/ drung nas bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don la zhabs brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ da na ba yun thung ba dang / 'chi ba zug chung ba byung na bsam pa ma gtogs bya ba 'di rang ma 'grub snyam pa'i blo'i lhag ma lus pa med gsungs nas/ gang la skyabs na bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ /'bral med spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs su gsol/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa/ /sems snong med kyi glu skad 'di bzhin len/ /shul na 'phreng ba'i zas nor lus pa med/ /gdong na 'tsher ba'i las ngan bsags pa med/ /theg chen bslab pa'i bsam sbyor nyams pa med/ /da sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /ci snang sgyu mar rtogs pa'i shes rab yod/ /'gro drug pha mar shes pa'i lhag bsam yod/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i nyams len yod/ /da sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /thog mar gsung rab dgongs don tshul bzhin btsal/ /bar du blo gsal gdul bya'i tshogs la bshad/ /tha mar 'dris pa'i don la rtse gcig bsgoms/ /da sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa srog las gces par bzung / /rigs dang mi rigs tshul bzhin rnam par phye/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas dal 'byor don yod byas/ /da sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /'gyod med bde drod kyi mgur ma 'di/ /gangs bu le'i 'gul du blangs pa yin/ /mi kho bo'i rjes 'jug bskal ldan rnams/ /mi nga bzhin byed na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /gsung ba bzhin gong du bstan pa de ltar 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa rgyas par gsungs nas/ chos nang par gyi grol bar gda'o/ /zhes gsungs zhing / nang par chos gsung ba'i dus mar bcad bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan nas/ gsung mi gnang zhing / gsol mi dgongs tsam ma gtogs snyung zug med pas/ thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams ma chag cing /

ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin 'pho ba mdzad nas/ 'brug lo zla ba bcu pa'i nyer dgu'i nyi shar la/ sku lus gzugs kyi sku 'od gsal chos kyi skur mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /skye 'chi la dbang thob pa yin te/ bsam bzhin du srid pa bzhes zhing bzhed pa shin tu mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /sgyu lus kun rdzob bden pa rnam par dag /'od gsal don dam bden pa mngon du gyur/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes/ /phrin las lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis 'chi ba 'od gsal las bar du sgyu lus su bzhengs nas/ kun rdzob bden pa rnam par dag pa mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa longs sku mnyes te/ rten de nyid la 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku mngon sum du mngon du mdzad pa ni/ dbang phyug brgyad ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyed par 'gyur te/ zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam pa bzhis 'bad med lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad du gzhan don mdzad pas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho skems par mdzad do/ /zhing gzhan gshegs tshe sa chen rab tu g.yos/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lha rnams 'dus gyur te/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba de kho nas/ /mchod nas spyan drangs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ skyes bu dam pa rnams bltams pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i sa g.yo bar/ mdo las gsungs pa ltar byung ba kun la gsal lo/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha klu sogs nam mkha' la 'dus par gyur te/ phyi'i mchod pa 'dod yon lnga/ nang mchod pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba'i mchod pa dga' bzhi'i bde ba/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta bas rang rang gis ji ltar nus pa ltar mchod nas/

bdag nyid chen po gar gshegs pa'i gnas su spyan drangs pa yin no/ /kun gyis thos pa'i dung dang rnga bo che'i sgra skad bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / sngar snam ma myong ba'i dri bzang po kun gyis tshor ba yang yang byung / bla ma bsod nams grags pa sogs 'ga' yar gyi mtshan mo bla brang kun 'od kyis khengs pa gzigs/ de la sogs pa dge ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /ye shes me yis khyod sku bzhu ba'i tshe/ /mkha' la sprin med bar snang rlung yang zhi/ /sa la drod rgyas dbyar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ /rten 'brel dbang thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phye nas/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa rgyas par phul te/ ye shes lnga'i mes rnam par smin pa'i sku sbyang ba'i tshe/ skad cig de nyid la rgyan nam mkha' sprin sogs sgrib g.yogs kun dang bral zhing bai ḍūr+ya'i rang mdog yongs su rdzogs par bstan/ bar snang la rlung dang tshub ma sogs kyi rdul dang bral bar gyur/ sa gzhi la glo bur drod cher rgyas te/ grang pas nyen dang bral ba/ dbyar bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la dbang thob/ lta ba rnam par dag pa'i mthu yin par kun gyis go'o/ ston pa'i sku gdung cha brgyad bsgos pa bzhin/ /khyod gdung dad ldan lha klu grangs med kyis/ /phyogs bcur spyan drangs mchod pa'i rten du gyur/ /sku gdung rgyas mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ sngon gyad kyi yul sa la zung gi drung du/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su/ sku gdung ring bsrel rnams lha dang klu dang mi rnams kyis cha brgyad du bgos pa bzhin du bdag nyid chen po 'di'i sku gdung byin rlabs kyi snying po can rnams kyi skal ba dang / lha klu sogs mi ma yin gyis kyang spyan drangs par grags te/ gdung khang zhal phye dus phyag zhabs kyi rkang 'ga' yar la tshang bar mthun snang du grub bo/

/lhag ma rnams nang rten gyi rten sku 'dra'i nang du zhugs rgyu dang / bu slob kyi mchog chos rje blo bzang grags pas gtso mdzad/ rab tu byung ba'i gdul bya rnams dang / sbyin bdag gi mchog tu gyur pa khri bsod nams rgyal mtshan lde pa sku mched kyis thog grangs phyi ma'i gdul bya rnams la bkye nas lha klu'i gnas dang bod gangs can gyi khrod thams cad du mchod pa'i rten du gyur to/ /mthong thos dran reg gtam du brjod rnams kyis/ /'di phyi bar do'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad/ /bslu med skyabs gnas dpal ldan red mda' ba/ /'dren mchog dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni/ dpal ldan bla ma de'i sku mthong ba'am gsung thos pa'am yon tan dran pa'am phrin las kyis reg pa'am/ mtshan brjod pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi tshe 'di'i mgon phyi ma'i skyabs/ bar do'i dpung gnyen dam par gyur pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug kun tu bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas dam pa de la bdag sogs gdul bya thams cad sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi zhing phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /bstod do/ /rnam pa kun tu rjes su bzung du gsol/ kye ma kyi hud bstan ba'i srog shing chag /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun phyogs bcur 'thor lags so/ /kye ma kyi hud thar pa'i rgyal mtshan 'gyel/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi thar lam stor lags so/ /kye ma kye hud legs bshad dga' ston nyams/ /blo gsal rnams kyi re thag chad lags so/ /kye ma kye hud lta ba'i nyi ma nub/ /klu sgrub yab sras lugs bzang su yis skyong / /kye ma kyi hud dam chos rgya mtsho skams/ /thogs med sku mched bshad srol su yis ston/ /kye ma kye hud lung rig mche sder 'thor/ /phyogs glang chos grags rigs tshul su yis spel/ /kye ma kye hud tshul khrims bum pa zhig /yon shāka rnam gnyis sdom brgyud su yis 'dzin/ /kye ma kye hud spangs rtogs go rim 'chol/

/'phags seng gnyis kyi legs bshad su yis sgrogs/ /kye ma kye hud nyams rtogs byin rlabs yal/ /ti lo nā ro'i man ngag su la zhu/ /kye ma kye hud phan bde'i pad tshal zum/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa phyogs bcur nub lags so/ /kye ma kye hud nyams thag yid re mug /khyod sku mig gis mthong ba'i bskal bas dben/ /khyod gsung rna bas thos pa'i bsod nams med/ /khyod thugs gang na bzhugs kyang byin gyis brlabs/ /rjes su mchod pa phul ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma bsod nams grags pas gtso mdzad/ bu slob brgya phrag gcig lhag tsam gyis/ zhag bco brgyad kyi bar du phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di dag gi zhal phye nas gus pas gsol ba btab pa ni/ bla ma bsod nams grags pa dang / /chen po chos dpal ba gnyis kyis gtso mdzad kyis kyai rdo rje/ slob dpon yi dam dpal ba dang / bla ma yon rgyal bas gtso mdzad rnams kyis kun rig bla ma rgyal bzang bas gtso mdzad/ bya bral ba rnams kyis chos rje'i thugs dam gyi gtso bo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das bde mchog 'khor lo/ slob dpon bka' bzhi pas gtso mdzad/ dge 'dun byin gyis bde gshegs brgyad la phyag dang mchod pa/ bdag gis bla ma mchod pa la sogs pa'i sgrub mchod phul te/ gsol ba btab/ de dus nang so rang gi phyag rdzas gang yod kyis ci ldangs byas pa'i lhag ma/ khab nang sos zhag gsum/ bdag chen mas zhag gnyis/ drung slob dpon mas gtso mdzad rnams kyis zhag gsum bteg nas/ gdung gi drung nas gtso mdzad dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bskur 'bul 'degs phun sum tshogs pa mdzad cing / nang rang gi phyag rdzas kyis gung thang chos sde chen po yang / tsha ba mang ja gral 'gyed phun sum tshogs pa dang / sgrub sde bsam gtan gling du'ang / tsha ba gral 'gyed dang bcas pa yang mdzad do/ /nang rten rang byon 'phags pa'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs khri rgyab dang bcas pa bzhengs pa'i zangs gser/

bzo gnas pa'i yon rgyags sogs kyi 'thil zhugs/ drung bdag po bas mdzad cing / gzhan yang bdag chen mas gtso mdzad/ bu slob rnams kyis dad cing gus pas phul ba dang / nang so rang gis thig po sogs phyag rdzas kyi gzhug gang yod btang nas/ mang yul 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol zhing / sku 'dra'i sbyin bdag chen po chos dpal bas mdzad nas gtsug lag khang de nyid na bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag nyid chen po rang gis jo bo'i drung du phul ba'i kong bu la dngul dam gcig bsnan nas/ kong rkyen bzang po brtsegs te phul lo/ /rten gnyer chen po pa dang / slob dpon yon ring pas mdzad/ 'thil bzhugs bla ma rgyal bzang pa dang / nye gnas mchog legs pas mdzad do/ /gzhan yang gdan sa chen mos gtso mdzad/ bo dong / snar thang / zhwa lu/ gnas snying / chos 'khor sgang / dpal gsang phu ne'u thog ri bo dge 'phel la sogs pa'i/ chos grwa chen po rnams su'ang gang la gang 'os kyi mang ja 'gyed dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ chos rje blo bzang grags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang / nang brten rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang mnyam pa bzhengs nas/ ri bo dge 'phel na bzhugs so/ /dge legs yon tan chu gter chen po las/ /chu thig tsam zhig blangs la nyes pa'i tshogs/ /ji snyed mchis pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /zhabs 'bring gnyug ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /bla ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung 'di/ /bshes gnyen bsod nams grags sogs bkas bskul nas/ /grangs med gdul bya'i tha shal mnga' ris pa/ /mi phyed dad thob sangs rgyas rtse mos sbyar/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan/ /ma lus blo yis gcig tu bsdoms byas nas/ /bla ma mchog la gus pas phul ba yis/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /rnam thar zhib rgyas su brjod pa blo'i yul ma yin zhing / bdag nyid chen po'i drung nas kyang /

ngas 'di ltar byas/ 'di bzhin byung sogs cher mi gsung pa dang / rgyun du zhags tog phul ba'i rgyus can la 'dri med pa'i stobs kyis/ go rim gong 'og nor ba sogs/ nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ 'di phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces pa 'di dbang phyug mi la ras chen gyi bsti gnas rkang tshugs phug gi ri khrod du sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza gtāṃ// / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 60 sangs rgyas rtse mo/ red mda' ba'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 61
